"""Small source-role boundaries shared by rule matching and model admission.

These helpers recognize a complete grammatical frame, not the action words
inside a quotation.  Unrecognized phrasing remains eligible for the existing
semantic fallback.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Sequence

from minicode.intent_negation import ACTION_MARKER_RE


_CONTENT_NOUN_ZH = r"(?:文案|文本|文字|标签|标题|内容|消息|提示|字符串|占位符)"
_CONTENT_NOUN_EN = r"(?:label|text|caption|title|message|content|string|placeholder|prompt)"
_SOURCE_NOUN_ZH = (
    r"(?:网页|页面|按钮|控件|输入框|屏幕|界面|菜单|字段|弹窗|警告|错误|日志)"
)
_SOURCE_NOUN_EN = (
    r"(?:button|control|input|dialog|menu|field|page|warning|error|"
    r"current|existing|original)"
)
_ATTRIBUTION_PREFIX_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?:(?:这个|那个|该|当前|现有|原来)?"
    rf"(?:{_SOURCE_NOUN_ZH}(?:的|上的?|里的?|中的?)?){{0,4}}{_CONTENT_NOUN_ZH}"
    r"\s*(?:是|为|写着|显示为|叫作|叫做)|"
    rf"(?:(?:the|this|that|a|an|our|its)\s+)?(?:{_SOURCE_NOUN_EN}\s+){{0,4}}"
    rf"{_CONTENT_NOUN_EN}\s+(?:is|reads|says|shows|displays))\s*[:：]?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_RE = re.compile(r"[。！？!?;；\n]|\.(?=\s|$)")
_LITERAL_END_RE = re.compile(r"\s*(?:[,，。.!！?？;；\n]|$)")


def attributed_literal_statement_spans(
    text: str, literal_spans: Sequence[tuple[int, int]]
) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
    """Extend quoted payloads to complete ``the label is '...'`` statements.

    The attribution must start a sentence and end at the literal.  A relative
    clause or parenthesized object in an actual request does not satisfy that
    frame.  Only the statement through its closing quote is covered, leaving
    even an unrecognized colloquial request in the next sentence visible.
    """

    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for literal_start, literal_end in sorted(literal_spans):
        # The parser may pass its already merged protected spans back to the
        # semantic admission path. Recover the payload start only when the
        # span itself begins with this same complete attribution frame.
        contained_prefix = _ATTRIBUTION_PREFIX_RE.match(text, literal_start, literal_end)
        if contained_prefix is not None:
            literal_start = contained_prefix.end()
        if not _LITERAL_END_RE.match(text, literal_end):
            continue
        prefix_start = 0
        for boundary in _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_RE.finditer(text, 0, literal_start):
            prefix_start = boundary.end()
        prefix = text[prefix_start:literal_start]
        if _ATTRIBUTION_PREFIX_RE.fullmatch(prefix):
            spans.append((prefix_start, literal_end))
    return tuple(spans)


def mask_attributed_literal_statements(
    text: str, protected_spans: Sequence[tuple[int, int]]
) -> str:
    """Hide only recognized attribution statements from provider requests.

    Ordinary quoted objects remain in the request.  Offsets are retained so
    an adjacent current request still receives its original production span.
    """

    characters = list(text)
    for start, end in attributed_literal_statement_spans(text, protected_spans):
        ending = _LITERAL_END_RE.match(text, end)
        if ending is not None:
            end = ending.end()
        for index in range(start, end):
            if characters[index] not in "\r\n":
                characters[index] = " "
    return "".join(characters)


_EXPLANATION_FRAME_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?:(?:请|麻烦|帮我)\s*)?(?:我\s*)?(?:只|仅|只是)?\s*"
    r"(?:解释|说明|讲讲|说说|想知道)(?:一?下)?[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{0,160}"
    r"(?:含义|意思|意义|风险)(?:是什么|就好|即可|就行)?\s*[。.!！?？]?\s*|"
    r"\s*(?:please\s+)?(?:only\s+|just\s+)?"
    r"(?:explain|describe|tell\s+me(?:\s+about)?)\s+[^.!?;\n]{0,160}"
    r"(?:meaning|means|phrase|term|label|caption|text|impact|risk)"
    r"\s*[.!?]?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_VISIBLE_COORDINATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"[,，;；\n]|然后|再|并|另外|接着|随后|以及|还要|"
    r"\b(?:and|then|also|next|afterwards|separately)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def is_bounded_explanation_request(masked_text: str) -> bool:
    """Recognize one explicit request for meaning, without a second command.

    This is a proposal restriction, not a classifier: the provider can still
    supply a read/analysis intent.  Visible coordination deliberately declines
    this narrow restriction because it may introduce another genuine request.
    Quoted coordination was already removed by the caller's literal mask.
    """

    return bool(
        _EXPLANATION_FRAME_RE.fullmatch(masked_text)
        and _VISIBLE_COORDINATION_RE.search(masked_text) is None
    )


# These are grammatical question heads, not a list of verbs to forbid.  In
# particular the addressee is absent from the modal-subject frame: ``Can you
# update this file?`` remains an ordinary request despite its question mark.
_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT_ZH = (
    r"(?:(?:这|那)(?:个|条|项|段)?|该|此|上述|上面的?|刚才的?)?"
    r"(?:命令|脚本|程序|函数|方法|工具|操作|参数|选项|设置|配置|补丁|改动)|"
    r"它|(?:[a-zA-Z_][\w./-]*\.(?:py|js|ts|sh))"
)
_PASSIVE_SUBJECT_ZH = (
    r"(?:(?:这|那)(?:些|个)?|该)?(?:缓存|临时|配置|日志|旧|现有|本地|"
    r"工作区的|缓存目录中的|目标目录中的){0,4}(?:文件|目录|数据|缓存)"
)
_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT_EN = (
    r"(?:it|this|that|(?:the|this|that|our)\s+"
    r"(?:command|script|program|function|method|tool|operation|option|setting|"
    r"change|patch|build|test|migration))"
)
_ADVICE_QUESTION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?:(?:(?:你|您)(?:觉得|认为)\s*)?(?:我|我们)?"
    r"(?:应该|该)?(?:怎样|如何|怎么)|"
    r"(?:这|那)(?:个|段|份|项)?[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{1,32}"
    r"(?:应该|该)(?:怎样|如何|怎么))[^。！？!?;；\n]+[?？]\s*|"
    r"\s*how\s+(?:should|would|could|can|do|does)\s+"
    rf"(?:I|we|one|{_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT_EN})\b[^!?;\n]+\?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_ARTIFACT_EFFECT_QUESTION_RE = re.compile(
    rf"\s*(?:为什么)?(?:{_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT_ZH})\s*(?:为什么)?"
    r"(?:是否会|是不是会|会不会|会|"
    r"是否|能否|可否|是不是)[^。！？!?;；\n]+[?？]\s*|"
    rf"\s*(?:{_PASSIVE_SUBJECT_ZH})\s*(?:是否会|会不会|会)被"
    r"[^。！？!?;；\n]+[?？]\s*|"
    r"\s*(?:will|would|does|do|could|can|should)\s+"
    rf"{_ARTIFACT_SUBJECT_EN}\b[^!?;\n]+\?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_DISCUSSION_ONLY_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?:(?:我|我们)(?:现在|这次|本轮)?(?:想|要)?)?"
    r"(?:只|仅|只是)\s*(?:讨论|分析|评估)(?:一下)?"
    r"(?:方案|思路|影响|风险|可行性)(?:就好|就行|即可)?\s*[。.!！]?\s*|"
    r"\s*(?:please\s+)?(?:only|just)\s+(?:discuss|analy[sz]e|assess)\s+"
    r"(?:the\s+)?(?:plan|approach|impact|risks?|feasibility)\s*[.!]?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_NOMINAL_INFORMATION_QUESTION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?P<subject>[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{1,100}?)"
    r"(?P<question>(?:分别|各自|具体|到底)?(?:有什么(?:用|作用|用途|意义|含义)|"
    r"(?:是|做)什么|是什么意思|有何(?:意义|含义|作用)))\s*[?？]\s*",
)
_EXPLICIT_REQUEST_RESET_RE = re.compile(
    r"[,，(（]\s*(?:(?:另外|顺便|然后|接着|随后|再|同时|并且|并)\s*)?"
    r"(?=(?:请|帮我|麻烦|给我|替我))|"
    r",\s*(?:(?:and|then|also|next)\s+)*"
    r"(?=(?:please|kindly|(?:can|could|would|will)\s+you)\b)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_INCIDENTAL_REQUEST_RESET_RE = re.compile(r"[,，(（]\s*(?:顺便|另外)\s*")
_ADDRESSED_ACTION_PREFIX_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:请你|请您|帮我|帮我们|替我|替我们)\s*"
    r"(?:(?:直接|现在|立即)\s*)?|"
    r"\b(?:please|kindly|help\s+me)\s+(?:be\s+)?",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_READ_REQUEST_WORDS = frozenset({
    "解释", "说明", "分析", "检查", "审查", "搜索", "查找", "比较", "对比",
    "explain", "describe", "analyze", "analyse", "inspect", "review", "search",
    "find", "compare",
})


def _contains_addressed_action(sentence: str) -> bool:
    for request in _ADDRESSED_ACTION_PREFIX_RE.finditer(sentence):
        action = ACTION_MARKER_RE.match(sentence, request.end())
        if action is not None and action.group().casefold() not in _READ_REQUEST_WORDS:
            return True
    return False


def _question_request_reset(sentence: str) -> re.Match[str] | None:
    resets = list(_EXPLICIT_REQUEST_RESET_RE.finditer(sentence))
    resets.extend(
        match
        for match in _INCIDENTAL_REQUEST_RESET_RE.finditer(sentence)
        if ACTION_MARKER_RE.match(sentence, match.end()) is not None
    )
    return min(resets, key=lambda match: match.start()) if resets else None


def _is_nominal_information_question(sentence: str) -> bool:
    match = _NOMINAL_INFORMATION_QUESTION_RE.fullmatch(sentence)
    return bool(
        match is not None
        # A bare noun subject can own a wh predicate. An imperative before
        # that predicate must retain its own authority, e.g. ``修改帮助文本
        # 告诉用户这些选项有什么用？``. Let existing rules handle such input.
        and ACTION_MARKER_RE.search(match.group("subject")) is None
    )


def _request_sentences(text: str) -> tuple[tuple[str, tuple[int, int]], ...]:
    """Keep sentence-local roles without treating dots in paths as stops."""

    sentences: list[tuple[str, tuple[int, int]]] = []
    start = 0
    for boundary in _SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_RE.finditer(text):
        end = boundary.end()
        if text[start:end].strip():
            sentences.append((text[start:end], (start, end)))
        start = end
    if text[start:].strip():
        sentences.append((text[start:], (start, len(text))))
    return tuple(sentences)


def readonly_request_spans(masked_text: str) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
    """Locate complete advisory or third-person effect questions.

    A question's subject can contain an action verb without granting action
    authority.  Its scope ends with the sentence, so a following imperative
    is still independent. Callers must mask quotations before this analysis.
    """

    return tuple(sorted((
        *readonly_question_spans(masked_text),
        *(span
        for sentence, span in _request_sentences(masked_text)
        if _DISCUSSION_ONLY_RE.fullmatch(sentence)),
    )))


def readonly_question_spans(masked_text: str) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
    """Question frames that can supply a missing deterministic read intent.

    An explicit discussion-only constraint still leaves its semantic domain
    unresolved, so it is restricted by admission without inventing a label.
    """

    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for sentence, (start, end) in _request_sentences(masked_text):
        if not (
            _ADVICE_QUESTION_RE.fullmatch(sentence)
            or _ARTIFACT_EFFECT_QUESTION_RE.fullmatch(sentence)
            or _is_nominal_information_question(sentence)
        ):
            continue
        reset = _question_request_reset(sentence)
        if reset is not None:
            # A comma plus a fresh polite imperative grants separate
            # authority even when the user puts one question mark at the end.
            end = start + reset.start()
        if _contains_addressed_action(sentence[:end - start]):
            # Object-fronted polite requests (``这个函数能否帮我重构`` /
            # ``Could this function please be refactored``) still address the
            # assistant. A third-person subject alone cannot make them inert.
            continue
        spans.append((start, end))
    return tuple(spans)


def question_request_resets(masked_text: str) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
    """Expose question-to-imperative transitions to real clause matching.

    Merely shortening a role span is insufficient when one greedy verb rule
    consumed both clauses. Matching each side separately preserves the later
    command's independent action and concrete target.
    """

    resets: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for _start, end in readonly_question_spans(masked_text):
        reset = _question_request_reset(masked_text[end:])
        if reset is not None and reset.start() == 0:
            resets.append((end, end + reset.end()))
    return tuple(resets)


def is_discussion_action(
    masked_text: str, trigger_span: tuple[int, int]
) -> bool:
    """Whether a rule's verb belongs to a recognized read-only sentence."""

    start, end = trigger_span
    return any(
        frame_start <= start < end <= frame_end
        for frame_start, frame_end in readonly_request_spans(masked_text)
    )


def is_bounded_readonly_request(masked_text: str) -> bool:
    """Restrict model proposals only when every sentence has a read frame.

    An unrecognized sentence leaves normal semantic resolution available.
    This avoids spreading the first question's scope over an adjacent edit.
    """

    sentences = _request_sentences(masked_text)
    return bool(sentences) and all(
        any(
            not sentence[:start].strip() and not sentence[end:].strip()
            for start, end in readonly_request_spans(sentence)
        )
        or is_bounded_explanation_request(sentence)
        or is_conversational_read_request(sentence)
        for sentence, _span in sentences
    )


_CONVERSATIONAL_READ_FRAME_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?:(?:先|现在|这次|本轮|目前)\s*)?"
    r"(?:(?:请|帮我|麻烦你)\s*)?(?:(?:只|仅|只是)\s*)?"
    # Reduplicated conversational heads are explicit speech acts. Ordinary
    # ``说明/解释/分析`` may instead modify a noun (``说明文字换成英文``),
    # so their existing bounded explanation/analysis frames remain in charge.
    r"(?:聊聊|谈谈|讲讲|说说)(?:一下|下)?"
    r"[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{1,160}\s*[。.!！?？]?\s*",
)
_COLLOQUIAL_INFORMATION_QUESTION_RE = re.compile(
    r"\s*(?P<subject>[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{1,100}?)"
    r"(?:是)?(?:咋|怎么|如何)[^,，。！？!?;；\n]{1,100}"
    r"(?:啊|呀|呢|吗|么|嘛)\s*[。.!！?？]?\s*",
)


def is_conversational_read_request(masked_text: str) -> bool:
    """Recognize a bounded conversational reading role, leaving its label open."""

    if _VISIBLE_COORDINATION_RE.search(masked_text) is not None:
        return False
    if _CONVERSATIONAL_READ_FRAME_RE.fullmatch(masked_text):
        return True
    question = _COLLOQUIAL_INFORMATION_QUESTION_RE.fullmatch(masked_text)
    return bool(
        question is not None
        and ACTION_MARKER_RE.search(question.group("subject")) is None
    )

"""Fit and evaluate semantic-intent confidence from content-free labels."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

    INTENT_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFIER_CONTRACT_VERSION,

    load_calibration_observations,
    write_calibration_report,
)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "observations",
        type=Path,
        help=(
            "JSON array/object containing whole-response rawConfidence, "
            "correct, and split labels"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument("artifact_output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--version",
        required=True,
        help=(
            "Calibration artifact version (for example 2026-09-experiment-holdout-v1)"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model-key",
        required=True,
        help="Exact canonical model identifier used by the classifier runtime",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--classifier-contract-version",
        default=INTENT_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFIER_CONTRACT_VERSION,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--fit-split", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-split", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--bin-count", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--prior-alpha", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--prior-beta", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--acceptance-threshold", type=float, default=0.72)
    parser.add_argument("--report-output", type=Path)
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.fit_split == args.evaluation_split:
        parser.error("--fit-split and --evaluation-split must be distinct")
    observations = load_calibration_observations(args.observations)
    calibration = fit_confidence_calibration(
        observations,
        version=args.version,
        model_key=args.model_key,
        classifier_contract_version=args.classifier_contract_version,
        bin_count=args.bin_count,
        prior_alpha=args.prior_alpha,
        prior_beta=args.prior_beta,
        split=args.fit_split,
    )
    fit_metrics = evaluate_confidence_calibration(
        calibration,
        observations,
        acceptance_threshold=args.acceptance_threshold,
        split=args.fit_split,
    )
    evaluation_metrics = evaluate_confidence_calibration(
        calibration,
        observations,
        acceptance_threshold=args.acceptance_threshold,
        split=args.evaluation_split,
    )
    calibration.write(args.artifact_output)
    report = CalibrationReport(
        calibration_version=calibration.version,
        classifier_contract_version=calibration.classifier_contract_version,
        model_key=calibration.model_key,
        production_fit=calibration.production_fit,
        fit_split=args.fit_split,
        evaluation_split=args.evaluation_split,
        fit_metrics=fit_metrics,
        evaluation_metrics=evaluation_metrics,
    )
    if args.report_output is not None:
        write_calibration_report(args.report_output, report)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            report.to_dict(),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
            sort_keys=True,
            allow_nan=False,
        )
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def _finite_number(
    value: object,
    *,
    name: str,
    minimum: float,
    maximum: float,
) -> float:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be numeric")
    parsed = float(value)
    if not math.isfinite(parsed) or not minimum <= parsed <= maximum:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} is outside its allowed range")
    return parsed


def _bounded_integer(
    value: object,
    *,
    name: str,
    minimum: int,
    maximum: int,
) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer")
    if not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} is outside its allowed range")
    return value


def _boolean(value: object, *, name: str) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
            return False
    raise TypeError(f"{name} must be boolean")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IntentSemanticClassifierConfig:
    """Validated, non-secret controls for one semantic classifier instance."""

    enabled: bool = False

class _InvalidSemanticResponse(ValueError):
    pass


def _strict_object(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
    result: dict[str, object] = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("duplicate JSON key")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _reject_non_finite(_value: str) -> object:
    raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("non-finite JSON number")


def _supports_required_controls(
    model: object, extra_controls: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
) -> bool:
    try:
        parameters = inspect.signature(model.next).parameters
    except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    if any(
        parameter.kind is inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD
        for parameter in parameters.values()
    ):
        return True
    return (_REQUIRED_MODEL_CONTROLS | extra_controls).issubset(parameters)


def _safe_attribute(value: object, name: str, default: object = None) -> object:
    try:
        return getattr(value, name, default)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - malformed adapter results fail closed
        return default


def _semantic_model_key(model: object) -> str | None:
    """Resolve the exact model identifier used to bind calibration artifacts."""

    explicit = _safe_attribute(model, "catalog_model_key")
    if explicit is not None:
        return explicit if isinstance(explicit, str) else None
    runtime = _safe_attribute(model, "runtime")
    if isinstance(runtime, Mapping):
        configured = runtime.get("model")
        return configured if isinstance(configured, str) else None
    return model if isinstance(model, str) else None


def _bounded_payload(request: SemanticIntentRequest, maximum: int) -> str:
    """Build a bounded JSON payload, retaining the current request first."""
    current = str(request.text or "")[:maximum]
    remaining = max(0, maximum - len(current))

    active_task = str(request.context.active_task or "")[:remaining]
    remaining -= len(active_task)

    recent: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for turn in reversed(request.context.recent_turns):
        if remaining <= 0:
            break
        role = str(turn.role).strip().lower()
        if role not in {"user", "assistant"}:
            continue
        content = str(turn.content or "")[:remaining]
        if not content:
            continue
        remaining -= len(content)
        recent.append({"role": role, "content": content})
    recent.reverse()

    previous: dict[str, object] | None = None
    prior = request.context.previous_intent
    if prior is not None:
        previous = {
            "intent": prior.intent_type.value,
            "action": prior.action_type.value,
            "confidence": round(float(prior.confidence), 3),
        }

    allowed_pairs = {
        intent.value: sorted(action.value for action in actions)
        for intent, actions in sorted(
            SEMANTIC_INTENT_ALLOWED_ACTIONS.items(),
            key=lambda item: item[0].value,
        )
    }
    return json.dumps(
        {
            "currentRequest": current,
            "recentTurns": recent,
            "activeTask": active_task,
            "previousIntent": previous,
            "allowedPairs": allowed_pairs,
        },
        ensure_ascii=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        allow_nan=False,
    )


def _provider_envelope_byte_limit(content_byte_limit: int) -> int:
    """Bound provider metadata/JSON escaping separately from assistant content."""

    return min(
        _PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_MAX_BYTES,
        _PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_FIXED_OVERHEAD_BYTES
        + (content_byte_limit * _PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_CONTENT_EXPANSION),
    )


class BudgetedSemanticIntentClassifier(IntentSemanticAdapter):
    """A one-call semantic fallback sharing the Agent's production controls."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: object,
        *,
        config: IntentSemanticClassifierConfig,
        calibration: IntentConfidenceCalibration | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._model = model
        self._config = config
        model_key = _semantic_model_key(model)
        resolved_calibration = (
            calibration
            if calibration is not None
            else IntentConfidenceCalibration.load(
                Path(config.calibration_path) if config.calibration_path else None,
                expected_classifier_contract_version=(
                    INTENT_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFIER_CONTRACT_VERSION
                ),
                expected_model_key=model_key,
                allow_unreviewed_calibration=(config.allow_unreviewed_calibration),
            )
        )
        if not isinstance(resolved_calibration, IntentConfidenceCalibration):
            raise TypeError("calibration must be an IntentConfidenceCalibration")
        resolved_calibration.validate_for_runtime(
            classifier_contract_version=(INTENT_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFIER_CONTRACT_VERSION),
            model_key=model_key,
            allow_unreviewed_calibration=config.allow_unreviewed_calibration,
        )
        self._calibration = resolved_calibration
        self._local = threading.local()

    @property
    def last_status(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self._local, "last_status", "disabled"))

    def _set_status(self, status: str) -> None:
        self._local.last_status = status

    def _generation_controls(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        """Choose only controls supported by the resolved provider route.

        JSON object syntax is separate from native strict JSON Schema. The
        classifier still validates every field locally; provider capabilities
        do not grant tool access or expand the intent/action allowlist.
        """
        controls: dict[str, object] = {}
        if (
            self._config.json_mode
            and _safe_attribute(self._model, "supports_json_object", False) is True
        ):
            controls["json_object_override"] = True
        supported = _safe_attribute(self._model, "supported_reasoning_efforts", ())
        if (
            isinstance(supported, tuple)
            and self._config.reasoning_effort != "default"
            and self._config.reasoning_effort in supported
        ):
            controls["reasoning_effort_override"] = self._config.reasoning_effort
        return controls

    def infer(
        self,
        request: SemanticIntentRequest,
        *,
        call_context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[SemanticIntentProposal, ...]:
        self._set_status("disabled")
        if not self._config.enabled:
            return ()

        context = call_context if isinstance(call_context, Mapping) else {}
        budget = context.get("agent_budget")
        event_sink = context.get("event_sink")
        cancellation_token = context.get("cancellation_token")
        parent_deadline = context.get("deadline_monotonic")

        if not self._controls_available(budget, event_sink):
            self._set_status("control_unavailable")
            return ()
        generation_controls = self._generation_controls()
        if not _supports_required_controls(
            self._model, frozenset(generation_controls)
        ):
            self._set_status("control_unavailable")
            return ()

        checkpoint_model_call(
            cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
            deadline_monotonic=parent_deadline,
        )
        try:
            snapshot = budget.snapshot()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unsafe control means no model call
            self._set_status("control_unavailable")
            return ()
        if (
            snapshot.limit_model_calls is not None
            and snapshot.used_model_calls + self._config.reserve_model_calls
            >= snapshot.limit_model_calls
        ):
            self._set_status("budget_exhausted")
            return ()

        payload = _bounded_payload(request, self._config.max_input_chars)
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": _SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": payload},
        ]
        estimated_input = estimate_messages_tokens(messages)
        reservation: AgentBudgetReservation | None = None
        try:
            reservation = budget.reserve_model_call(
                estimated_input,
                preserve_model_calls=self._config.reserve_model_calls,
            )
        except AgentBudgetExceeded:
            self._set_status("budget_exhausted")
            return ()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unsafe control means no provider call
            self._set_status("control_unavailable")
            return ()

        now = time.monotonic()
        local_deadline = now + self._config.timeout_seconds
        parent_is_limit = False
        if parent_deadline is not None:
            try:
                parent_value = float(parent_deadline)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation)
                raise ModelCallDeadlineExceeded("model call deadline is invalid")
            if parent_value <= local_deadline:
                local_deadline = parent_value
                parent_is_limit = True

        operation_id = new_model_operation_id()
        started_at = time.monotonic()
        emit_event_safely(
            event_sink,
            "model.started",
            payload={"operationId": operation_id, "purpose": _PURPOSE},
        )
        try:
            step = call_model_next(
                self._model,
                messages,
                optional_kwargs={
                    "disable_tools": True,
                    "max_output_tokens_override": self._config.max_output_tokens,
                    "max_response_bytes_override": _provider_envelope_byte_limit(
                        self._config.max_output_bytes
                    ),
                    "temperature_override": 0.0,
                    "max_retries_override": 0,
                    "isolated_reasoning_state": True,
                    **generation_controls,
                },
                cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                deadline_monotonic=local_deadline,
            )
        except TurnCancellationRequested:
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation, charge_estimate=True)
            self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "interrupted", started_at)
            raise
        except ModelCallDeadlineExceeded:
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation, charge_estimate=True)
            try:
                checkpoint_model_call(
                    cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                    deadline_monotonic=parent_deadline,
                )
            except TurnCancellationRequested:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "interrupted", started_at)
                raise
            except ModelCallDeadlineExceeded:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "timeout", started_at)
                raise
            self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "timeout", started_at)
            if parent_is_limit or self._parent_deadline_elapsed(parent_deadline):
                raise
            self._set_status("timeout")
            return ()
        except TimeoutError:
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation, charge_estimate=True)
            try:
                checkpoint_model_call(
                    cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                    deadline_monotonic=parent_deadline,
                )
            except TurnCancellationRequested:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "interrupted", started_at)
                raise
            except ModelCallDeadlineExceeded:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "timeout", started_at)
                raise
            self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "timeout", started_at)
            if parent_is_limit:
                raise ModelCallDeadlineExceeded(
                    "parent model call deadline bounded the semantic call"
                ) from None
            self._set_status("timeout")
            return ()
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - semantic fallback abstains
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation, charge_estimate=True)
            # A provider may surface its own exception at the same instant the
            # caller cancels or its parent deadline expires.  Re-check the
            # parent controls before degrading to an advisory UNKNOWN result;
            # cancellation and parent deadlines are turn control flow.
            try:
                checkpoint_model_call(
                    cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                    deadline_monotonic=parent_deadline,
                )
            except TurnCancellationRequested:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "interrupted", started_at)
                raise
            except ModelCallDeadlineExceeded:
                self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "timeout", started_at)
                raise
            failure_kind = (
                "network"
                if isinstance(error, (ConnectionError, urllib.error.URLError))
                else "provider_error"
            )
            self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, failure_kind, started_at)
            self._set_status(failure_kind)
            return ()
        except BaseException:
            # KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit must not strand the shared token or
            # model-call lease, nor leave an orphan model.started event.
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation, charge_estimate=True)
            self._emit_failure(event_sink, operation_id, "interrupted", started_at)
            raise

        content = _safe_attribute(step, "content", "")
        usage = self._usage(step, messages, content)
        cost_payload = self._cost_payload(usage, operation_id)
        try:
            record_budgeted_model_call(
                budget,
                model=self._model,
                usage=usage,
                reservation=reservation,
                cost_payload=cost_payload,
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - accounting cannot expose content
            self._fail_reservation(budget, reservation)

        proposals, status, raw_min, calibrated_min = self._decode(step, request)
        duration = project_model_duration_ms(started_at, time.monotonic())
        completed_payload: dict[str, object] = {
            "operationId": operation_id,
            "purpose": _PURPOSE,
            "resultType": (
                _safe_attribute(step, "type", "unknown")
                if _safe_attribute(step, "type", "unknown")
                in {"assistant", "tool_calls"}
                else "unknown"
            ),
            "contentPresent": bool(isinstance(content, str) and content),
            "toolCallCount": self._tool_call_count(step),
            "usage": usage,
            "semanticStatus": status,
            "semanticOperationCount": len(proposals),
            "calibrationVersion": str(self._calibration.version)[:128],
            "calibrationProductionFit": self._calibration.production_fit,
            "semanticContentChars": min(len(content), self._config.max_output_bytes)
            if isinstance(content, str)
            else 0,
            "semanticStopReason": self._stop_reason(step),
            "semanticOutputLimitReached": self._stop_reason(step)
            in {"length", "max_tokens"},
            "semanticJsonMode": generation_controls.get("json_object_override")
            is True,
            "semanticReasoningEffort": generation_controls.get(
                "reasoning_effort_override", "default"
            ),
        }
        if raw_min is not None:
            completed_payload["rawConfidenceMinimum"] = round(raw_min, 4)
        if calibrated_min is not None:
            completed_payload["calibratedConfidenceMinimum"] = round(calibrated_min, 4)
        if duration is not None:
            completed_payload["durationMs"] = duration
        emit_event_safely(event_sink, "model.completed", payload=completed_payload)
        cost_payload["purpose"] = _PURPOSE
        emit_event_safely(event_sink, "model.costed", payload=cost_payload)
        self._set_status(status)
        return proposals

    @staticmethod
    def _stop_reason(step: object) -> str:
        diagnostics = _safe_attribute(step, "diagnostics")
        reason = _safe_attribute(diagnostics, "stopReason")
        if reason is None:
            return "unavailable"
        if isinstance(reason, str) and reason in {
            "stop", "length", "tool_calls", "content_filter", "end_turn",
            "max_tokens", "stop_sequence",
        }:
            return reason
        return "other"

    @staticmethod
    def _controls_available(budget: object, event_sink: object) -> bool:
        return (
            _safe_attribute(event_sink, "observation_active", False) is True
            and all(
                callable(getattr(budget, name, None))
                for name in (
                    "snapshot",
                    "reserve_model_call",
                    "record_model_call",
                    "fail_model_call",
                )
            )
            and callable(getattr(event_sink, "emit", None))
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _parent_deadline_elapsed(parent_deadline: object) -> bool:
        if parent_deadline is None:
            return False
        try:
            return time.monotonic() >= float(parent_deadline)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return True

    @staticmethod
    def _fail_reservation(
        budget: object,
        reservation: AgentBudgetReservation | None,
        *,
        charge_estimate: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            budget.fail_model_call(
                reservation,
                charge_estimate=charge_estimate,
            )
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - accounting is best effort here
            logger.warning("Semantic intent budget settlement failed.")

    @staticmethod
    def _emit_failure(
        event_sink: object,
        operation_id: str,
        failure_kind: str,
        started_at: float,
    ) -> None:
        payload: dict[str, object] = {
            "operationId": operation_id,
            "failureKind": failure_kind,
            "purpose": _PURPOSE,
        }
        duration = project_model_duration_ms(started_at, time.monotonic())
        if duration is not None:
            payload["durationMs"] = duration
        emit_event_safely(event_sink, "model.failed", payload=payload)

    def _usage(
        self,
        step: object,
        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
        content: object,
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        projected = project_model_usage(_safe_attribute(step, "usage", None))
        if (
            projected.get("source") == "provider"
            and isinstance(projected.get("inputTokens"), int)
            and isinstance(projected.get("outputTokens"), int)
        ):
            return projected
        return {
            "source": "estimated",
            "inputTokens": estimate_messages_tokens(messages),
            "outputTokens": estimate_tokens(
                content if isinstance(content, str) else ""
            ),
            "cacheReadTokens": 0,
            "cacheCreationTokens": 0,
        }

    def _cost_payload(
        self, usage: Mapping[str, object], operation_id: str
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        try:
            return project_model_cost_event(
                model=self._model,
                usage=usage,
                operation_id=operation_id,
            )
        except BaseException:  # noqa: BLE001 - optional observation only
            return pricing_failure_event_payload(operation_id)

    @staticmethod
    def _tool_call_count(step: object) -> int:
        calls = _safe_attribute(step, "calls", None)
        if not isinstance(calls, list):
            return 0
        return min(len(calls), 10_000)

    def _decode(
        self, step: object, request: SemanticIntentRequest
    ) -> tuple[
        tuple[SemanticIntentProposal, ...],
        str,
        float | None,
        float | None,
    ]:
        if _safe_attribute(step, "type", None) != "assistant" or self._tool_call_count(
            step
        ):
            return (), "tool_call_rejected", None, None
        if self._stop_reason(step) in {"length", "max_tokens"}:
            # Even a syntactically complete prefix need not contain every
            # requested operation when generation ended at the token limit.
            return (), "invalid_response", None, None
        content = _safe_attribute(step, "content", None)
        if not isinstance(content, str) or not content:
            return (), "invalid_response", None, None
        try:
            encoded_size = len(content.encode("utf-8"))
        except UnicodeEncodeError:
            return (), "invalid_response", None, None
        if encoded_size > self._config.max_output_bytes:
            return (), "invalid_response", None, None
        try:
            document = json.loads(
                content,
                object_pairs_hook=_strict_object,
                parse_constant=_reject_non_finite,
            )
            raw_operations = self._validate_document(document)
        except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            return (), "invalid_response", None, None
        if not raw_operations:
            return (), "abstained", None, None

        raw_confidences: list[float] = []
        calibrated_confidences: list[float] = []
        for operation in raw_operations:
            raw_confidence = float(operation["confidence"])
            calibrated = self._calibration.calibrate(raw_confidence)
            if not math.isfinite(calibrated) or not 0.0 <= calibrated <= 1.0:
                return (), "invalid_response", None, None
            raw_confidences.append(raw_confidence)
            calibrated_confidences.append(calibrated)
        raw_minimum = min(raw_confidences)
        calibrated_minimum = min(calibrated_confidences)
        if calibrated_minimum < self._config.min_confidence:
            return (), "low_confidence", raw_minimum, calibrated_minimum

        proposals: list[SemanticIntentProposal] = []
        for operation, calibrated in zip(
            raw_operations, calibrated_confidences, strict=True
        ):
            intent_type = IntentType(operation["intent"])
            action_type = ActionType(operation["action"])
            confidence = round(min(calibrated, _SEMANTIC_CONFIDENCE_CEILING), 3)
            proposals.append(
                SemanticIntentProposal(
                    intent_type=intent_type,
                    action_type=action_type,
                    polarity=IntentPolarity.AFFIRMED,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    clause=request.text,
                    span=None,
                    reason_code=(
                        f"semantic:classified-{intent_type.value}.{action_type.value}"
                    ),
                    reason="semantic fallback supports this operation",
                )
            )
        return (
            tuple(proposals),
            "accepted",
            raw_minimum,
            calibrated_minimum,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_document(document: object) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        if not isinstance(document, dict) or set(document) != {
            "schemaVersion",
            "operations",
        }:
            raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("unexpected top-level shape")
        if (
            isinstance(document["schemaVersion"], bool)
            or document["schemaVersion"] != _SCHEMA_VERSION
        ):
            raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("unsupported schema version")
        operations = document["operations"]
        if (
            not isinstance(operations, list)
            or not 0 <= len(operations) <= _MAX_OPERATIONS
        ):
            raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("invalid operation count")
        validated: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        for operation in operations:
            if not isinstance(operation, dict) or set(operation) != {
                "intent",
                "action",
                "confidence",
            }:
                raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("unexpected operation shape")
            try:
                intent_type = IntentType(operation["intent"])
                action_type = ActionType(operation["action"])
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("unknown intent or action") from None
            confidence = operation["confidence"]
            _finite_number(
                confidence,
                name="confidence",
                minimum=0.0,
                maximum=1.0,
            )
            if (
                intent_type in {IntentType.UNKNOWN, IntentType.SYSTEM}
                or action_type in _HIGH_RISK_ACTIONS
                or action_type
                not in SEMANTIC_INTENT_ALLOWED_ACTIONS.get(intent_type, frozenset())
            ):
                raise _InvalidSemanticResponse("disallowed intent/action pair")
            validated.append(
                {
                    "intent": intent_type.value,
                    "action": action_type.value,
                    "confidence": float(confidence),
                }
            )
        return validated


def build_semantic_intent_adapter(
    model: object,
    *,
    runtime: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> IntentSemanticAdapter | None:
    """Build the opt-in adapter without creating a provider client."""
    config = IntentSemanticClassifierConfig.from_runtime(runtime)
    if not config.enabled:
        return None
    try:
        calibration = IntentConfidenceCalibration.load(
            Path(config.calibration_path) if config.calibration_path else None,
            expected_classifier_contract_version=(
                INTENT_SEMANTIC_CLASSIFIER_CONTRACT_VERSION
            ),
            expected_model_key=_semantic_model_key(model),
            allow_unreviewed_calibration=config.allow_unreviewed_calibration,
        )
        return BudgetedSemanticIntentClassifier(
            model,
            config=config,
            calibration=calibration,
        )
    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        logger.warning(
            "Semantic intent calibration is unavailable; classifier disabled."
        )
        return None


__all__ = [
    "BudgetedSemanticIntentClassifier",
    "IntentSemanticClassifierConfig",
    "build_semantic_intent_adapter",
]

"""Logging configuration for MiniCode Python.

Provides structured logging with:
- 分级日志（DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR）
- 控制台和文件输出
- 日志轮转（按大小 + 按时间，防止无限增长）
- 结构化 JSON 日志（可选，便于机器解析）
- 关键路径日志点（API 调用、工具执行、权限检查）
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import logging.handlers
import os
import re
import sys
import traceback
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from minicode.config import MINI_CODE_DIR

# 日志文件路径
LOG_FILE = MINI_CODE_DIR / "minicode.log"

# 日志格式
CONSOLE_FORMAT = "%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s"
FILE_FORMAT = "%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s %(filename)s:%(lineno)d: %(message)s"

# 轮转配置
LOG_MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024   # 10 MB per file
LOG_BACKUP_COUNT = 5               # Keep 5 rotated files (50 MB total max)
LOG_ROTATION_WHEN = "midnight"     # Also rotate at midnight
LOG_ROTATION_INTERVAL = 1          # Every 1 day

_SECRET_ASSIGNMENT = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?P<prefix>[\"']?[a-z0-9_-]*(?:api[_-]?key|"
    r"auth(?:orization)?[_-]?token|access[_-]?token|password|secret)"
    r"[a-z0-9_-]*[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*)"
    r"(?:[\"'](?:bearer\s+)?[^\"'\r\n]*[\"']|"
    r"(?:bearer\s+)?[^\s,;}]+)"
)
_AUTHORIZATION = re.compile(
    r"(?i)(?P<prefix>[\"']?authorization[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*)"
    r"(?:[\"'](?:bearer\s+)?[^\"'\r\n]*[\"']|"
    r"(?:bearer\s+)?[^\s,;}]+)"
)
_KNOWN_KEY_TOKEN = re.compile(r"\bsk-(?:ant-|or-)?[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{8,}\b")


def redact_log_text(value: Any) -> str:
    """Remove common credential forms before text reaches any handler."""
    text = str(value)
    text = _AUTHORIZATION.sub(r"\g<prefix><redacted>", text)
    text = _SECRET_ASSIGNMENT.sub(r"\g<prefix><redacted>", text)
    return _KNOWN_KEY_TOKEN.sub("<redacted>", text)


class _RedactingFilter(logging.Filter):
    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
        record.msg = redact_log_text(record.getMessage())
        record.args = ()
        if record.exc_info:
            rendered = "".join(traceback.format_exception(*record.exc_info))
            record.exc_text = redact_log_text(rendered)
            record.exc_info = None
        return True


class _PrivateRotatingFileHandler(logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler):
    """Keep the active and newly rotated log files owner-readable only."""

    def _open(self):
        stream = super()._open()
        if os.name == "posix":
            os.chmod(self.baseFilename, 0o600)
        return stream


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structured JSON formatter
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class StructuredFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    """JSON structured log formatter for machine-parseable logs.
    
    Outputs each log entry as a single JSON line:
    {"ts": "2025-01-15T10:30:00", "level": "INFO", "module": "api", ...}
    """
    
    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
        entry = {
            "ts": datetime.fromtimestamp(record.created, tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "module": record.name,
            "msg": redact_log_text(record.getMessage()),
            "file": f"{record.filename}:{record.lineno}",
        }
        
        # Add structured extras if present
        for key in ("tool_name", "model", "duration_ms", "tokens_in", "tokens_out",
                     "cost", "error_category", "session_id", "workspace"):
            value = getattr(record, key, None)
            if value is not None:
                entry[key] = value
        
        # Add exception info
        if record.exc_info and record.exc_info[1] is not None:
            entry["exception"] = redact_log_text(record.exc_info[1])
            entry["exc_type"] = type(record.exc_info[1]).__name__
        
        return json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def setup_logging(
    level: str = "WARNING",
    log_to_file: bool = True,
    log_to_console: bool = True,
    structured: bool = False,
) -> logging.Logger:
    """配置 MiniCode 日志系统。
    
    Args:
        level: 日志级别（DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR）
        log_to_file: 是否输出到文件
        log_to_console: 是否输出到控制台
        structured: 是否使用 JSON 结构化日志格式
        
    Returns:
        配置好的根 logger
    """
    # 确保日志目录存在
    if log_to_file:
        MINI_CODE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if LOG_FILE.is_symlink():
            raise RuntimeError("log_file_symlink")
        if os.name == "posix":
            os.chmod(MINI_CODE_DIR, 0o700)
            if LOG_FILE.exists():
                os.chmod(LOG_FILE, 0o600)
    
    # 创建根 logger
    root_logger = logging.getLogger("minicode")
    root_logger.setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.WARNING))
    
    # 清除已有的 handlers（避免重复）
    root_logger.handlers.clear()
    
    # 选择格式化器
    if structured:
        file_formatter = StructuredFormatter()
        console_formatter = StructuredFormatter()
    else:
        file_formatter = logging.Formatter(FILE_FORMAT)
        console_formatter = logging.Formatter(CONSOLE_FORMAT)
    
    # 文件 handler — 使用 RotatingFileHandler 防止日志无限增长
    if log_to_file:
        # RotatingFileHandler: 按大小轮转
        file_handler = _PrivateRotatingFileHandler(
            LOG_FILE,
            maxBytes=LOG_MAX_BYTES,
            backupCount=LOG_BACKUP_COUNT,
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        file_handler.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)  # 文件记录所有级别
        file_handler.setFormatter(file_formatter)
        file_handler.addFilter(_RedactingFilter())
        root_logger.addHandler(file_handler)
    
    # 控制台 handler
    if log_to_console:
        console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stderr)
        console_handler.setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.WARNING))
        console_handler.setFormatter(console_formatter)
        console_handler.addFilter(_RedactingFilter())
        root_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
    
    # 减少第三方库的日志噪音
    for noisy_lib in ["urllib3", "httpx", "openai"]:
        logging.getLogger(noisy_lib).setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    
    root_logger.info("Logging initialized (level=%s, file=%s, console=%s, structured=%s)",
                     level, log_to_file, log_to_console, structured)
    
    return root_logger


def get_logger(name: str) -> logging.Logger:
    """获取子模块 logger。
    
    Args:
        name: 子模块名称（如 'agent_loop', 'tools.read_file'）
        
    Returns:
        配置好的子 logger
    """
    return logging.getLogger(f"minicode.{name}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structured logging helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def log_api_call(model: str, tokens_in: int, tokens_out: int, cost: float, duration_ms: float) -> None:
    """记录 API 调用信息（结构化）。"""
    logger = get_logger("api")
    logger.info(
        "API call: model=%s, tokens_in=%d, tokens_out=%d, cost=$%.4f, duration=%dms",
        model, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost, duration_ms,
        extra={
            "model": model,
            "tokens_in": tokens_in,
            "tokens_out": tokens_out,
            "cost": cost,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
        },
    )


def log_tool_execution(tool_name: str, success: bool, duration_ms: float, error: str | None = None) -> None:
    """记录工具执行信息（结构化）。"""
    logger = get_logger("tools")
    extra = {"tool_name": tool_name, "duration_ms": duration_ms}
    if success:
        logger.debug("Tool %s executed successfully in %dms", tool_name, duration_ms, extra=extra)
    else:
        extra["error_category"] = "tool_failure"
        logger.warning("Tool %s failed after %dms: %s", tool_name, duration_ms, error, extra=extra)


def log_permission_check(kind: str, target: str, granted: bool) -> None:
    """记录权限检查信息（结构化）。"""
    logger = get_logger("permissions")
    extra = {"tool_name": kind}
    if granted:
        logger.debug("Permission granted: %s for %s", kind, target, extra=extra)
    else:
        logger.warning("Permission denied: %s for %s", kind, target, extra=extra)


def log_session_event(event: str, details: str = "") -> None:
    """记录会话事件（启动、保存、恢复）。"""
    logger = get_logger("session")
    if details:
        logger.info("Session %s: %s", event, details)
    else:
        logger.info("Session %s", event)


def get_log_stats() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """获取当前日志文件统计信息（大小、轮转文件数等）。"""
    stats: dict[str, Any] = {
        "log_file": str(LOG_FILE),
        "exists": LOG_FILE.exists(),
    }
    
    if LOG_FILE.exists():
        size = LOG_FILE.stat().st_size
        stats["size_bytes"] = size
        stats["size_mb"] = round(size / (1024 * 1024), 2)
        stats["max_size_mb"] = LOG_MAX_BYTES / (1024 * 1024)
        stats["rotation_pct"] = round(size / LOG_MAX_BYTES * 100, 1)
    
    # Count rotated files
    rotated = list(LOG_FILE.parent.glob(f"{LOG_FILE.name}.*"))
    stats["rotated_files"] = len(rotated)
    stats["max_rotated"] = LOG_BACKUP_COUNT
    
    return stats

) -> str:

def _append_transcript(transcript: list[TranscriptEntry], **kwargs) -> None:
    transcript.append(TranscriptEntry(id=len(transcript) + 1, **kwargs))


def _make_cli_permission_prompt():
    """Create a simple CLI-based permission prompt for non-TTY fallback."""
    # Concurrent batch workers can hit permission checks at the same time;
    # interleaved print/input from two threads would corrupt the question
    # and swallow one answer. Serialize prompts so each stays readable.
    prompt_lock = threading.Lock()

    def _prompt(request: dict) -> dict:
        with prompt_lock:
            print(f"\n{request.get('summary', 'Permission Request')}")
            choices = request.get("choices", [])
            if choices:
                for choice in choices:
                    print(f"  [{choice.get('key', '')}] {choice.get('label', '')}")
                answer = input("Choose: ").strip()
                for choice in choices:
                    if answer == choice.get("key"):
                        return {"decision": choice.get("decision", "allow_once")}
            answer = input("Allow? (y/n): ").strip().lower()
            return {"decision": "allow_once" if answer in ("y", "yes") else "deny_once"}

    return _prompt


def _configure_stdio_for_unicode() -> None:
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        reconfigure = getattr(stream, "reconfigure", None)
        if reconfigure is not None:
            try:
                reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            except Exception:
                pass


def _save_transcript_file(
    cwd: str, permissions, transcript: list[TranscriptEntry], output_path: str
) -> str:
    target = resolve_tool_path(
        ToolContext(cwd=cwd, permissions=permissions), output_path, "write"
    )
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(format_transcript_text(transcript), encoding="utf-8")
    return str(target)


def _route_skills_for_prompt(
    cwd: str,
    tools,
    user_input: str | None,
    *,
    call_context: dict | None = None,
    parsed_intent=None,
    refresh_catalog: bool = True,
) -> tuple[list[dict], object | None]:
    from minicode.skill_catalog_context import refresh_skill_catalog_for_turn

    if refresh_catalog:
        refresh_skill_catalog_for_turn(cwd, tools)
    if not user_input:
        return tools.get_skills(), None
    from minicode.capability_registry import (
        build_tool_capability_snapshot,
    )
    from minicode.skill_router import build_skill_router
    from minicode.skill_routing_turn import (
        SkillRoutingTurnAdapters,
        SkillRoutingTurnRequest,
        route_skill_turn,
    )

    turn_routing = route_skill_turn(
        SkillRoutingTurnRequest(
            prompt=user_input,
            parsed_intent=parsed_intent,
            skills=tools.get_skills(),
            registry=build_tool_capability_snapshot(tools),
        ),
        SkillRoutingTurnAdapters(router=build_skill_router(cwd)),

    )
    return list(turn_routing.prompt_skills), turn_routing.routing

                            model=model,

                            messages=messages,

                            permissions=permissions,

                                observation.tool_started(tool_name)

                            ),
                            skill_load_policy=skill_load_policy_for_routing(
                                skill_routing
                            ),

                            trusted_user_evidence=stable_constraint_seeds(
                                user_input
                            ),
                        )
                        returned_assistant = next(
                            (
                                message
                                for message in reversed(messages)
                                if message.get("role") == "assistant"
                            ),
                            None,
                        )
                        returned_content = (
                            returned_assistant.get("content")
                            if isinstance(returned_assistant, dict)
                            else None
                        )
                        observation.assistant_completed(
                            content_present=(
                                isinstance(returned_content, str)
                                and bool(returned_content)
                            ),
                            content_length=(
                                len(returned_content)
                                if isinstance(returned_content, str)
                                else 0
                            ),
                        )
                finally:
                    permissions.end_turn()

                    stats = context_mgr.get_stats()
                    logger.debug(
                        "After turn: %d tokens (%.0f%%)",
                        stats.total_tokens,
                        stats.usage_percentage,
                    )
                last_response = final_response_text(messages)
                if last_response:
                    _append_transcript(
                        transcript, kind="assistant", body=last_response
                    )
                    print(last_response)
            return

        run_tty_app(
            runtime=runtime,
            tools=tools,
            model=model,
            messages=messages,
            cwd=cwd,
            permissions=permissions,
            resume_session=args.resume,
            list_sessions_only=args.list_sessions,
            memory_manager=memory_mgr,
            context_manager=context_mgr,
        )
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n\nInterrupted by user. Shutting down gracefully...")
    finally:
        # Graceful shutdown: clean up all resources
        from minicode.logging_config import get_logger

        logger = get_logger("main")
        logger.info("Shutting down...")

        # Dispose tools (closes MCP connections)
        try:
            tools.dispose()
            logger.info("Tools disposed successfully")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("Error disposing tools: %s", e)

        logger.info("Shutdown complete")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Safe, run-scoped MCP runtime observation projection.

This module owns the stable server key, low-cardinality failure classifier,
and closed payload projection for MCP runtime facts.  It never stores raw MCP
configuration, command lines, request/response payloads, stderr, or exception
text.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from minicode.mcp_event_contract import (
    MCP_ACTIVITY,
    MCP_FAILURE_KINDS,
    MCP_OUTCOMES,
    MCP_PROTOCOLS,
    MCP_RUNTIME_EVENT,
    MCP_TRANSPORT,
    MCP_VERSION,
    SERVER_KEY_RE,
    normalize_mcp_runtime_payload,
)
from minicode.run_events import AgentEventSink, emit_event_safely
from minicode.run_journal import stable_workspace_id


def mcp_server_key(workspace: str | Path, server_name: str) -> str:
    """Return the deterministic, workspace-scoped, non-reversible server key."""
    workspace_identity = stable_workspace_id(workspace)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(
        f"{workspace_identity}\0{server_name}".encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()[:32]
    return f"mcpsrv_{digest}"


def classify_mcp_failure(error: BaseException | None) -> str:
    """Classify an MCP failure without returning original exception text."""
    if error is None:
        return "other"
    if isinstance(error, TimeoutError):
        return "timeout"
    error_type = type(error).__name__.casefold()
    if "timeout" in error_type:
        return "timeout"
    text = str(error).casefold()
    if "timed out" in text or "timeout" in text:
        return "timeout"
    if "command not found" in text or "no such file" in text or "not in the allowed list" in text:
        return "command_not_found"
    if "process exited" in text or "closed before completing" in text:
        return "process_exit"
    if "json" in text or "protocol" in text or "content-length" in text:
        return "protocol_error"
    if text.startswith("mcp ") or "tools/call" in text or "request" in text:
        return "request_error"
    return "other"


def project_mcp_runtime_observation(
    *,
    workspace: str | Path,
    server_name: str,
    outcome: str,
    connection_attempted: bool,
    protocol: str | None = None,
    failure: BaseException | str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Project one terminal MCP tool-request fact into the closed safe schema."""
    if outcome not in MCP_OUTCOMES:
        raise ValueError("invalid MCP outcome")
    if not isinstance(connection_attempted, bool):
        raise ValueError("invalid MCP connectionAttempted")
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "mcpVersion": MCP_VERSION,
        "serverKey": mcp_server_key(workspace, server_name),
        "transport": MCP_TRANSPORT,
        "activity": MCP_ACTIVITY,
        "outcome": outcome,
        "connectionAttempted": connection_attempted,
    }
    if protocol is not None:
        if protocol not in MCP_PROTOCOLS:
            raise ValueError("invalid MCP protocol")
        payload["protocol"] = protocol
    if outcome != "request_succeeded":
        if isinstance(failure, str):
            failure_kind = failure if failure in MCP_FAILURE_KINDS else "other"
        else:
            failure_kind = classify_mcp_failure(failure)
        payload["failureKind"] = failure_kind
    elif failure is not None:
        raise ValueError("successful MCP observation cannot include failure")
    normalized = normalize_mcp_runtime_payload(payload)
    if normalized is None:
        raise ValueError("invalid MCP runtime payload")
    return normalized


def emit_mcp_runtime_observation_safely(
    sink: AgentEventSink | None,
    *,
    step: int | None,
    workspace: str | Path,
    server_name: str,
    outcome: str,
    connection_attempted: bool,
    protocol: str | None = None,
    failure: BaseException | str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Emit one MCP runtime fact without allowing observation failure into MCP."""
    if sink is None:
        return
    try:
        payload = project_mcp_runtime_observation(
            workspace=workspace,
            server_name=server_name,
            outcome=outcome,
            connection_attempted=connection_attempted,
            protocol=protocol,
            failure=failure,
        )
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - observation is optional and best effort
        return
    emit_event_safely(sink, MCP_RUNTIME_EVENT, step=step, payload=payload)


__all__ = [
    "MCP_ACTIVITY",
    "MCP_FAILURE_KINDS",
    "MCP_OUTCOMES",
    "MCP_PROTOCOLS",
    "MCP_RUNTIME_EVENT",
    "MCP_TRANSPORT",
    "MCP_VERSION",
    "SERVER_KEY_RE",
    "classify_mcp_failure",
    "emit_mcp_runtime_observation_safely",
    "mcp_server_key",
    "project_mcp_runtime_observation",
]

_MEMORY_MANAGER_TRANSACTION_STATE = threading.local()


def _active_memory_manager_transaction() -> object | None:
    """Return this thread's manager owner, clearing inherited fork state."""

    pid = os.getpid()
    if getattr(_MEMORY_MANAGER_TRANSACTION_STATE, "pid", None) != pid:
        _MEMORY_MANAGER_TRANSACTION_STATE.pid = pid

def _authority_state_digest_for_data(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Bind every field that can make one persisted entry injectable.

    The approval-content hash remains the version identity used by feedback.
    This second, derived seal prevents a versioned decoder from silently
    replacing missing or edited authority fields with permissive defaults.
    It is an integrity invariant, not a secret-key signature.
    """

    payload = {
        "digestVersion": 1,
        "id": data.get("id"),
        "scope": data.get("scope"),
        "tier": data.get("tier"),
        "lifecycle_status": data.get("lifecycle_status"),
        "curator_locked": data.get("curator_locked"),
        "safety_status": data.get("safety_status"),
        "safety_reason": data.get("safety_reason"),
        "approval_status": data.get("approval_status"),
        "approval_content_hash": data.get("approval_content_hash"),
        "approval_reason": data.get("approval_reason"),
        "approval_actor": data.get("approval_actor"),
        "approval_decided_at": data.get("approval_decided_at"),
        "approval_policy": data.get("approval_policy"),
        "deprecated_at": data.get("deprecated_at"),
        "tier_reason": data.get("tier_reason"),
    }
    encoded = json.dumps(
        payload,
        sort_keys=True,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def _derived_usefulness_score(success_count: int, failure_count: int) -> float:
    total = success_count + failure_count
    return (
        (success_count - failure_count) / total
        if total
        else 0.0
    )


def _saturating_counter_add(current: int, increment: int = 1) -> int:
    """Advance a persisted JSON counter without making the store unwritable."""

    if type(current) is not int or type(increment) is not int:
        raise TypeError("Memory counters require integer arithmetic")
    if current < 0 or increment < 0:
        raise ValueError("Memory counters cannot be negative")
    return min(MAX_MEMORY_COUNTER, current + increment)


def _bounded_age_hours(timestamp: float, *, now: float | None = None) -> float:
    """Return a non-negative age so future clock skew cannot amplify rank."""

    reference = time.time() if now is None else now
    return max(0.0, (reference - timestamp) / 3600.0)


def _fits_persistence_depth(value: object, *, initial_depth: int = 1) -> bool:
    """Match the canonical persistence sanitizer's structural depth budget."""

    stack: list[tuple[object, int]] = [(value, initial_depth)]
    while stack:
        current, depth = stack.pop()
        if depth > _PERSISTENCE_MAX_DEPTH:
            return False
        if isinstance(current, dict):
            stack.extend((nested, depth + 1) for nested in current.values())
        elif isinstance(current, list):
            stack.extend((nested, depth + 1) for nested in current)
    return True


def _parse_memory_write_receipt_authority(
    value: object,
    *,
    expected_scope: str,
    authority_schema_version: int | None = None,
) -> dict[
    str,
    MemoryAuthorityCommit | MemoryAuthorityReceiptReference,
]:
    """Parse inline legacy receipts or current content-addressed references."""

    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) > _MAX_MEMORY_WRITE_RECEIPTS:
        raise ValueError("invalid_memory_write_receipts")
    receipts: dict[
        str,
        MemoryAuthorityCommit | MemoryAuthorityReceiptReference,
    ] = {}
    current_references = (
        authority_schema_version in _RECEIPT_REFERENCE_SCHEMA_VERSIONS
    )
    for raw_receipt in value:
        receipt = (
            MemoryAuthorityReceiptReference.from_dict(raw_receipt)
            if current_references
            else MemoryAuthorityCommit.from_dict(raw_receipt)
        )
        if receipt.scope != expected_scope or receipt.operation_id in receipts:
            raise ValueError("invalid_memory_write_receipts")
        if isinstance(receipt, MemoryAuthorityCommit):
            receipt.to_json()
        receipts[receipt.operation_id] = receipt
    return receipts


def _parse_pipeline_operation_receipt_authority(
    value: object,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parse the aggregate receipts shared by every authority reader."""

    if (
        not isinstance(value, list)
        or len(value) > _MAX_PIPELINE_OPERATION_RECEIPTS
    ):
        raise ValueError("invalid_pipeline_operation_receipts")
    receipts: dict[str, str] = {}
    for raw_receipt in value:
        if not isinstance(raw_receipt, dict) or set(raw_receipt) != {
            "operationId",
            "aggregateDigest",
        }:
            raise ValueError("invalid_pipeline_operation_receipts")
        operation_id = raw_receipt.get("operationId")
        aggregate_digest = raw_receipt.get("aggregateDigest")
        if (
            not isinstance(operation_id, str)
            or _MEMORY_WRITE_OPERATION_RE.fullmatch(operation_id) is None
            or not isinstance(aggregate_digest, str)
            or _MEMORY_WRITE_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(aggregate_digest) is None
            or operation_id in receipts
        ):
            raise ValueError("invalid_pipeline_operation_receipts")
        receipts[operation_id] = aggregate_digest
    return receipts


def _parse_observation_receipt_authority(
    value: object,
) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    """Parse bounded, content-free multi-scope delivery receipts by lane."""

    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != _OBSERVATION_RECEIPT_LANES:
        raise ValueError("invalid_observation_receipts")
    receipts: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
    for lane in sorted(_OBSERVATION_RECEIPT_LANES):
        raw_lane = value.get(lane)
        if (
            not isinstance(raw_lane, list)
            or len(raw_lane) > _MAX_OBSERVATION_RECEIPTS_PER_LANE
        ):
            raise ValueError("invalid_observation_receipts")
        lane_receipts: dict[str, str] = {}
        for raw_receipt in raw_lane:
            if not isinstance(raw_receipt, dict) or set(raw_receipt) != {
                "observationDigest",
                "payloadDigest",
            }:
                raise ValueError("invalid_observation_receipts")
            observation_digest = raw_receipt.get("observationDigest")
            payload_digest = raw_receipt.get("payloadDigest")
            if (
                not isinstance(observation_digest, str)
                or _MEMORY_WRITE_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(observation_digest) is None
                or not isinstance(payload_digest, str)
                or _MEMORY_WRITE_DIGEST_RE.fullmatch(payload_digest) is None
                or observation_digest in lane_receipts
            ):
                raise ValueError("invalid_observation_receipts")
            lane_receipts[observation_digest] = payload_digest
        receipts[lane] = lane_receipts
    return receipts
