        )
        return True

    def _validate_memories(self, report: CuratorReport | None = None) -> tuple[int, int]:
        """Check if memory-referenced files/patterns still exist in workspace."""
        if not self._workspace:
            return 0, 0

        from minicode.memory import MemoryScope

        stale = 0
        validated = 0
        changed = 0
        touched: set[MemoryScope] = set()

        scanned = 0
        for scope in MemoryScope:
            if scope not in self._memory.memories:
                continue
            for entry in self._memory.memories[scope].entries:
                self._cycle_checkpoint(scanned)
                scanned += 1
                paths = self._extract_entry_paths(getattr(entry, "content", ""))
                if not paths:
                    continue
                normalized_paths = [
                    normalized
                    for raw in paths
                    if (normalized := self._normalize_workspace_path(raw)) is not None
                ]
                if not normalized_paths:
                    continue
                validated += 1
                statuses = [self._path_status(path) for path in normalized_paths]
                if report is not None:
                    report.stale_paths_checked = len(self._path_status_cache)
                any_exists = any(status.exists is True for status in statuses)
                any_unknown = any(status.exists is None for status in statuses)
                all_missing = not any_exists and not any_unknown
                if all_missing and normalized_paths:
                    if self._mark_stale_entry(scope, entry):
                        touched.add(scope)
                        changed += 1
                    stale += 1

        for scope in touched:
            self._cycle_checkpoint()
            if hasattr(self._memory.memories[scope], "_rebuild_indices"):
                self._memory.memories[scope]._rebuild_indices()
            if hasattr(self._memory, "_save_approval_audit"):
                self._memory._save_approval_audit(scope)
            if hasattr(self._memory, "_save_scope"):
                self._memory._save_scope(scope)
                if report is not None:
                    report.scopes_saved += 1

        if report is not None:
            report.entries_changed += changed
            report.stale_entries = stale
        return stale, validated

    def _link_memories_optimized(self, report: CuratorReport | None = None) -> int:
        """Create related_to links without all-pairs comparison."""
        from minicode.memory import MemoryScope

        links = 0
        touched: set[MemoryScope] = set()
        changed_entry_ids: set[str] = set()
        max_link_candidates = min(50_000, max(1_000, self._max_candidate_pairs // 6))
        max_link_comparisons = min(50_000, max(1_000, self._max_similarity_comparisons // 6))
        max_links_per_entry = 8
        for scope_index, scope in enumerate(MemoryScope):
            self._cycle_checkpoint(scope_index)
            if scope not in self._memory.memories:
                continue
            entries = [
                entry
                for entry in self._memory.memories[scope].entries
                if getattr(entry, "is_active", True)
            ]
            signatures = self._build_duplicate_signatures(entries)
            candidates, truncated, stop_reason = self._candidate_pairs(
                signatures,
                0.4,
                max_pairs=max_link_candidates,
            )
            by_index = {signature.index: signature for signature in signatures}
            comparisons = 0
            link_degree: Counter[str] = Counter({
                str(getattr(signature.entry, "id", "")): min(
                    len(getattr(signature.entry, "related_to", []) or []),
                    max_links_per_entry,
                )
                for signature in signatures
            })
            pairs: list[tuple[Any, Any]] = []
            for candidate_index, (i, j) in enumerate(sorted(candidates)):
                self._cycle_checkpoint(candidate_index)
                if comparisons >= max_link_comparisons:
                    truncated = True
                    stop_reason = f"link comparison budget exceeded ({max_link_comparisons})"
                    break
                a = by_index[i]
                b = by_index[j]
                a_id = str(getattr(a.entry, "id", ""))
                b_id = str(getattr(b.entry, "id", ""))
                if link_degree[a_id] >= max_links_per_entry or link_degree[b_id] >= max_links_per_entry:
                    continue
                comparisons += 1
                union_size = len(a.tokens | b.tokens)
                similarity = len(a.tokens & b.tokens) / union_size if union_size else 0.0
                if similarity >= 0.4:
                    pairs.append((a.entry, b.entry))
                    link_degree[a_id] += 1
                    link_degree[b_id] += 1
            if report is not None:
                report.candidate_pairs += min(len(candidates), max_link_candidates)
                report.similarity_comparisons += comparisons
                if truncated:
                    report.recommendations.append(
                        f"Curator linking capped for {scope.value}: {stop_reason}"
                    )
            for pair_index, (a, b) in enumerate(pairs):
                self._cycle_checkpoint(pair_index)
                changed = False
                a_id = str(getattr(a, "id", ""))
                b_id = str(getattr(b, "id", ""))
                if b_id and b_id not in getattr(a, "related_to", []):
                    a.related_to.append(b_id)
                    changed = True
                    links += 1
                if a_id and a_id not in getattr(b, "related_to", []):
                    b.related_to.append(a_id)
                    changed = True
                    links += 1
                if changed:
                    touched.add(scope)
                    changed_entry_ids.add(a_id)
                    changed_entry_ids.add(b_id)
                    if hasattr(a, "invalidate_tokens"):
                        a.invalidate_tokens()
                    if hasattr(b, "invalidate_tokens"):
                        b.invalidate_tokens()
                    if hasattr(a, "_seal_authority_state"):
                        a._seal_authority_state()
                    if hasattr(b, "_seal_authority_state"):
                        b._seal_authority_state()

        for scope in touched:
            self._cycle_checkpoint()
            if hasattr(self._memory.memories[scope], "_rebuild_indices"):
                self._memory.memories[scope]._rebuild_indices()
            if hasattr(self._memory, "_save_scope"):
                self._memory._save_scope(scope)
                if report is not None:
                    report.scopes_saved += 1
        if report is not None:
            report.entries_changed += len(changed_entry_ids)
        return links

    # ── Insight consolidation ──────────────────────────────────

    def _consolidate_insights(
        self,
        report: CuratorReport | None = None,
        agent_budget: Any = None,
        event_sink: Any = None,
        cancellation_token: Any = None,
        deadline_monotonic: float | None = None,
    ) -> int:
        """Find related memory clusters and synthesize insights via LLM."""
        from minicode.memory import MemoryScope

        created = 0
        for scope_index, scope in enumerate(MemoryScope):
            self._cycle_checkpoint(scope_index)
            if scope not in self._memory.memories or created >= self._max_insights:
                break
            entries = [
                e for e in self._memory.memories[scope].entries
                if getattr(e, "is_active", True)
            ]
            clusters = self._find_clusters(entries, report=report)
            for cluster_index, cluster in enumerate(
                clusters[:self._max_insights - created]
            ):
                self._cycle_checkpoint(cluster_index)
                before_ids = {e.id for e in self._memory.memories[scope].entries}
                insight = self._synthesize_insight(
                    cluster,
                    agent_budget=agent_budget,
                    event_sink=event_sink,
                    cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                    deadline_monotonic=deadline_monotonic,
                )
                self._cycle_checkpoint()
                if insight:
                    from minicode.memory import MemoryApprovalPolicy, MemoryTier
                    entry = self._memory.add_entry(
                        scope=scope,
                        category="insight",
                        content=insight,
                        tags=["curator-insight"],
                        domains=list(set(d for e in cluster for d in e.domains)),
                        tier=MemoryTier.LONG_TERM,
                        source="curator",
                        provenance={
                            "related_to": [e.id for e in cluster],
                            "cluster_size": len(cluster),
                        },
                        approval_policy=MemoryApprovalPolicy.USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED,
                    )
                    if entry:
                        was_existing = entry.id in before_ids
                        entry.related_to = list(dict.fromkeys(entry.related_to + [e.id for e in cluster]))
                        if hasattr(entry, "_seal_authority_state"):
                            entry._seal_authority_state()
                        if not was_existing and hasattr(self._memory, "_save_scope"):
                            self._cycle_checkpoint()
                            self._memory._save_scope(scope)
                            if report is not None:
                                report.scopes_saved += 1
                            created += 1

        return created

    def _find_clusters(self, entries: list, report: CuratorReport | None = None) -> list[list]:
        """Find clusters of related memories using related_to + Jaccard."""
        if len(entries) < 3:
            return []

        # Use existing related_to links as seeds
        clusters: list[set[int]] = []
        seen: set[int] = set()
        id_to_index = {e.id: i for i, e in enumerate(entries)}

        for i, entry in enumerate(entries):
            self._cycle_checkpoint(i)
            if i in seen or not entry.related_to:
                continue
            cluster: set[int] = {i}
            frontier = [i]
            while frontier:
                cur = frontier.pop()
                for rid in entries[cur].related_to:
                    j = id_to_index.get(rid)
                    if j is not None and j not in cluster:
                        cluster.add(j)
                        frontier.append(j)
            if len(cluster) >= 3:
                clusters.append(cluster)
                seen |= cluster

        # Fallback: candidate-filtered Jaccard clustering for unlinked entries.
        remaining = [entry for i, entry in enumerate(entries) if i not in seen]
        signatures = self._build_duplicate_signatures(remaining)
        pairs, candidate_pairs, comparisons, partial, stop_reason = self._similar_entry_pairs(
            signatures,
            threshold=self._min_sim_consolidate,
            max_pairs=self._max_candidate_pairs,
            max_comparisons=self._max_similarity_comparisons,
        )
        if report is not None:
            report.candidate_pairs += candidate_pairs
            report.similarity_comparisons += comparisons
            if partial:
                report.status = "partial"
                report.stop_reason = stop_reason
                report.duplicate_candidates_truncated = True
        parent: dict[str, str] = {entry.id: entry.id for entry in remaining}

        def find(entry_id: str) -> str:
            while parent[entry_id] != entry_id:
                parent[entry_id] = parent[parent[entry_id]]
                entry_id = parent[entry_id]
            return entry_id

        def union(a: str, b: str) -> None:
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra != rb:
                parent[max(ra, rb)] = min(ra, rb)

        for pair_index, (a, b) in enumerate(pairs):
            self._cycle_checkpoint(pair_index)
            union(a.id, b.id)
        by_root: dict[str, set[int]] = {}
        for entry in remaining:
            group_index = id_to_index.get(entry.id)
            if group_index is not None:
                by_root.setdefault(find(entry.id), set()).add(group_index)
        for cluster in by_root.values():
            if len(cluster) >= 3:
                clusters.append(cluster)
                seen |= cluster

        return [[entries[i] for i in c] for c in clusters[:5]]

    def _synthesize_insight(
        self,
        cluster: list,
        *,
        agent_budget: Any = None,
        event_sink: Any = None,
        cancellation_token: Any = None,
        deadline_monotonic: float | None = None,
    ) -> str | None:
        """Call LLM to synthesize an insight from a memory cluster."""
        texts = "\n".join(
            f"- [{e.id}] {e.content[:150]}" for e in cluster[:5]
        )
        prompt = CONSOLIDATE_PROMPT.format(memory_texts=texts)
        if not self._model or not (
            hasattr(self._model, "generate") or hasattr(self._model, "next")
        ):
            return self._rule_based_insight(cluster)

        budget_reservation = None
        operation_id = new_model_operation_id()
        started_at = time.monotonic()
        request_started = False
        model_identity = self._model_identity()
        try:
            self._cycle_checkpoint()
            if agent_budget is not None:
                try:
                    budget_reservation = agent_budget.reserve_model_call(
                        max(1, len(prompt) // 4),
                        preserve_model_calls=1,
                    )
                except AgentBudgetExceeded:
                    logger.info(
                        "Curator insight synthesis skipped: shared Agent "
                        "turn budget exhausted"
                    )
                    return None
            emit_event_safely(
                event_sink,
                "model.started",
                payload={
                    "operationId": operation_id,
                    "purpose": "memory_curation",
                },
            )
            if self._model and hasattr(self._model, 'generate'):
                request_started = True
                raw = self._model.generate(prompt)
                self._cycle_checkpoint()
                if isinstance(raw, dict):
                    result = raw.get("content", "") or raw.get("text", "")
                else:
                    result = str(raw)
                result = result.strip()
                usage = ModelUsage(
                    input_tokens=max(1, len(prompt) // 4),
                    output_tokens=max(1, len(result) // 4),
                    source="estimated",
                )
            elif self._model and hasattr(self._model, 'next'):
                msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
                request_started = True
                step = call_model_next(
                    self._model,
                    msgs,
                    cancellation_token=cancellation_token,
                    deadline_monotonic=deadline_monotonic,
                )
                result = getattr(step, 'content', '') or ""
                result = result.strip()
                usage = getattr(step, 'usage', None)
            else:  # pragma: no cover - guarded before reserving the budget
                return self._rule_based_insight(cluster)

            usage_payload = project_model_usage(usage)
            try:
                cost_payload = project_model_cost_event(
                    model=model_identity,
                    usage=usage_payload,
                    operation_id=operation_id,
                )
            except BaseException:  # noqa: BLE001 - observation stays optional
                cost_payload = pricing_failure_event_payload(operation_id)
            record_budgeted_model_call(
                agent_budget,
                model=model_identity,
                usage=usage_payload,
                reservation=budget_reservation,
                cost_payload=cost_payload,
            )
            completed: dict[str, object] = {
                "operationId": operation_id,
                "purpose": "memory_curation",
                "resultType": "assistant",
                "contentPresent": bool(result),
                "toolCallCount": 0,
                "usage": usage_payload,
            }
            duration_ms = project_model_duration_ms(
                started_at, time.monotonic()
            )
            if duration_ms is not None:
                completed["durationMs"] = duration_ms
            emit_event_safely(
                event_sink, "model.completed", payload=completed
            )
            cost_payload["purpose"] = "memory_curation"
            emit_event_safely(
                event_sink, "model.costed", payload=cost_payload
            )
            if 30 < len(result) < 500:
                return result
        except AgentBudgetExceeded:
            logger.info(
                "Curator insight synthesis skipped: shared Agent turn "
                "budget exhausted"
            )
        except (TurnCancellationRequested, CuratorClaimLost):
            self._fail_model_call(
                agent_budget,
                budget_reservation,
                event_sink,
                operation_id,
                started_at,
                "interrupted",
                charge_estimate=request_started,
            )
            raise
        except ModelCallDeadlineExceeded:
            self._fail_model_call(
                agent_budget,
                budget_reservation,
                event_sink,
                operation_id,
                started_at,
                "timeout",
                charge_estimate=request_started,
            )
            logger.info("Curator insight synthesis stopped at Agent deadline")
        except Exception as e:
            self._fail_model_call(
                agent_budget,
                budget_reservation,
                event_sink,
                operation_id,
                started_at,
                "provider_error",
                charge_estimate=request_started,
            )
            logger.debug("Curator insight synthesis failed: %s", e)

        return self._rule_based_insight(cluster)

    def _model_identity(self) -> str:
        runtime = getattr(self._model, "runtime", None)
        if isinstance(runtime, dict):
            configured = runtime.get("model")
            if isinstance(configured, str) and configured:
                return configured
        return str(getattr(self._model, "model_id", "") or "curator-model")

    @staticmethod
    def _fail_model_call(
        agent_budget: Any,
        reservation: Any,
        event_sink: Any,
        operation_id: str,
        started_at: float,
        failure_kind: str,
        *,
        charge_estimate: bool,
    ) -> None:
        settle = getattr(agent_budget, "fail_model_call", None)
        if callable(settle):
            try:
                settle(reservation, charge_estimate=charge_estimate)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - fallback remains available
                pass
        payload: dict[str, object] = {
            "operationId": operation_id,
            "purpose": "memory_curation",
            "failureKind": failure_kind,
        }
        duration_ms = project_model_duration_ms(started_at, time.monotonic())
        if duration_ms is not None:
            payload["durationMs"] = duration_ms
        emit_event_safely(event_sink, "model.failed", payload=payload)

    def _rule_based_insight(self, cluster: list) -> str | None:
        """Produce the existing deterministic fallback without model telemetry."""
        domains = set(d for e in cluster for d in e.domains)
        common_words = self._extract_common_words([e.content for e in cluster])
        if common_words:
            return (
                f"[Auto] Memories in {', '.join(domains) or 'general'} share patterns: "
                f"{', '.join(common_words[:5])}. "
                f"({len(cluster)} related entries)"
            )
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _extract_common_words(contents: list[str], min_len: int = 3) -> list[str]:
        """Extract common significant words across multiple texts."""
        from collections import Counter
        word_sets = []
        for c in contents:
            words = {w.lower().strip(".,;:()[]{}'\"") for w in c.split()
                    if len(w) > min_len and not w.startswith("http")}
            word_sets.append(words)
        if not word_sets:
            return []
        common = word_sets[0]
        for ws in word_sets[1:]:
            common = common & ws
        freq = Counter()
        for c in contents:
            freq.update(w.lower().strip(".,;:()[]{}'\"") for w in c.split()
                       if len(w) > min_len and w.lower().strip(".,;:()[]{}'\"") in common)
        return [w for w, _ in freq.most_common(10)]

    # ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    def get_history(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [r.to_dict() for r in self._report_history[-10:]]

    def get_last_report(self) -> CuratorReport | None:
        return self._report_history[-1] if self._report_history else None

            "model_id": model,
            "prompt_version": HYBRID_PROMPT_VERSION,

                HYBRID_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode("utf-8")
            ).hexdigest(),

                HYBRID_CHALLENGER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode("utf-8")

        },

def bounded_hybrid_text(value: Any, limit: int) -> str:
    """Return the canonical model-visible normalization for Hybrid evidence."""

    if limit < 0:
        raise ValueError("hybrid text limit must be non-negative")
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", str(value or ""))
    visible = "".join(
        f"<U+{ord(character):04X}>"
        if unicodedata.category(character) == "Cf"
        else character
        for character in normalized
    )
    return " ".join(visible.split())[:limit]


def bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(
    values: Any,
    *,
    lowercase: bool = False,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Project complete identity values; never create a truncated identity."""

    if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
        return ()
    projected: list[str] = []
    for item in values[:HYBRID_MODEL_LIST_LIMIT]:
        value = bounded_hybrid_text(item, HYBRID_MODEL_STRING_LIMIT + 1)
        if not value or len(value) > HYBRID_MODEL_STRING_LIMIT:
            continue
        projected.append(value.casefold() if lowercase else value)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(projected))


def _stable_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def evidence_fingerprint(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    body = {key: value for key, value in payload.items() if key != "report_fingerprint"}
    return hashlib.sha256(_stable_json(body).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def hybrid_resolver_pressure_receipt_is_valid(value: Any) -> bool:
    """Validate the zero-event resolver safety receipt bound to Qwen evidence."""

    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
        "artifact",
        "report_fingerprint",
        "holdout_sha256",
        "manifest_sha256",
        "counts",
        "approved_one_sided_exact_95_upper",
    }:
        return False
    artifact_raw = value.get("artifact")
    if not isinstance(artifact_raw, str) or not artifact_raw:
        return False
    artifact = PurePosixPath(artifact_raw)
    if (
        artifact.is_absolute()
        or ".." in artifact.parts
        or artifact.as_posix() != HYBRID_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_ARTIFACT
    ):
        return False
    hex_characters = frozenset("0123456789abcdef")
    for key in ("report_fingerprint", "holdout_sha256", "manifest_sha256"):
        digest = value.get(key)
        if (
            not isinstance(digest, str)
            or len(digest) != 64
            or any(character not in hex_characters for character in digest)
        ):
            return False
    if (
        not HYBRID_ACCEPTED_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_REPORT_FINGERPRINT
        or value.get("report_fingerprint")
        != HYBRID_ACCEPTED_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_REPORT_FINGERPRINT
        or value.get("holdout_sha256") != HYBRID_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_HOLDOUT_SHA256
        or value.get("manifest_sha256") != HYBRID_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_MANIFEST_SHA256
    ):
        return False
    counts = value.get("counts")
    if not isinstance(counts, dict) or counts != {
        "case_count": HYBRID_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_CASE_COUNT,
        "raw_relevant_count": 0,
        "approved_count": 0,
    }:
        return False
    upper = value.get("approved_one_sided_exact_95_upper")
    expected_upper = 1.0 - 0.05 ** (1.0 / float(HYBRID_RESOLVER_PRESSURE_CASE_COUNT))
    return bool(
        not isinstance(upper, bool)
        and isinstance(upper, (int, float))
        and math.isfinite(float(upper))
        and abs(float(upper) - expected_upper) <= 1e-15
        and float(upper) <= 0.05
    )

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HybridCandidateSignal:
    entry_id: str
    dense_score: float
    relevance_score: float
    accepted: bool
    reason_codes: tuple[str, ...]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        import math

        if not self.entry_id:
            raise ValueError("hybrid candidate entry_id is required")
        for name in ("dense_score", "relevance_score"):
            value = float(getattr(self, name))
            if not math.isfinite(value) or not 0.0 <= value <= 1.0:
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and in [0, 1]")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "reason_codes",
            tuple(dict.fromkeys(str(item)[:64] for item in self.reason_codes if item)),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HybridAdjudication:
    signals: tuple[HybridCandidateSignal, ...]
    diagnostics: dict[str, Any]
    # None is the legacy "not supplied" sentinel. An explicit empty tuple is
    # a real empty cohort and must never be rewritten to all signal IDs.
    candidate_ids: tuple[str, ...] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        signals = tuple(self.signals)
        ids = [item.entry_id for item in signals]
        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
            raise ValueError("hybrid candidate IDs must be unique")
        candidate_ids = (
            None if self.candidate_ids is None else tuple(self.candidate_ids)
        )
        if candidate_ids is None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "signals", signals)
            object.__setattr__(self, "diagnostics", dict(self.diagnostics))
            return
        if len(candidate_ids) != len(set(candidate_ids)):
            raise ValueError("hybrid candidate cohort IDs must be unique")
        if not set(candidate_ids) <= set(ids):
            raise ValueError("hybrid candidate cohort must be represented by signals")
        accepted_ids = {item.entry_id for item in signals if item.accepted}
        if not accepted_ids <= set(candidate_ids):
            raise ValueError(
                "accepted hybrid signals must belong to the candidate cohort"
            )
        object.__setattr__(self, "signals", signals)
        object.__setattr__(self, "diagnostics", dict(self.diagnostics))
        object.__setattr__(self, "candidate_ids", candidate_ids)

def _strict_json_object(raw: bytes) -> Any:
    """Decode UTF-8 JSON while rejecting ambiguous duplicate object keys."""

    def reject_duplicates(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key, value in pairs:
            if key in result:
                raise ValueError(f"duplicate JSON key: {key}")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def reject_non_finite(value: str) -> Any:
        raise ValueError(f"non-finite JSON number: {value}")

    return json.loads(
        raw.decode("utf-8"),
        object_pairs_hook=reject_duplicates,
        parse_constant=reject_non_finite,
    )


def _read_bounded_regular_file(path: Path, *, maximum_bytes: int) -> bytes:
    """Read one opened non-symlink inode without a stat/read race."""

    if not hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW"):
        raise OSError("no-follow file reads are unavailable")
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    descriptor = os.open(path, flags)
    try:
        metadata = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode):
            raise OSError("evidence is not a regular file")
        if metadata.st_size > maximum_bytes:
            raise OverflowError("evidence is oversized")
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        remaining = maximum_bytes + 1
        while remaining > 0:
            chunk = os.read(descriptor, min(64 * 1024, remaining))
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
            remaining -= len(chunk)
        raw = b"".join(chunks)
        if len(raw) > maximum_bytes:
            raise OverflowError("evidence is oversized")
        return raw
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


def _qwen_evaluator_freeze_is_well_formed(value: Any) -> bool:
    """Validate the evaluator-source certificate's closed, self-bound shape."""

    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
        "schema_version",
        "file_count",
        "files",
        "aggregate_sha256",
    }:
        return False
    file_count = value.get("file_count")
    files = value.get("files")
    if (
        value.get("schema_version")
        != QWEN_PROMOTION_IMPLEMENTATION_FREEZE_SCHEMA_VERSION
        or isinstance(file_count, bool)
        or not isinstance(file_count, int)
        or not 1 <= file_count <= 128
        or not isinstance(files, list)
        or len(files) != file_count
    ):
        return False
    seen_paths: set[str] = set()
    for row in files:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"path", "sha256"}:
            return False
        path_raw = row.get("path")
        digest = row.get("sha256")
        if not isinstance(path_raw, str) or not path_raw:
            return False
        path = PurePosixPath(path_raw)
        if (
            path.is_absolute()
            or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != path_raw
            or path_raw in seen_paths
            or not isinstance(digest, str)
            or len(digest) != 64
            or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in digest)
        ):
            return False
        seen_paths.add(path_raw)
    aggregate = value.get("aggregate_sha256")
    body = {
        "schema_version": value["schema_version"],
        "file_count": file_count,
        "files": files,
    }
    expected = hashlib.sha256(_stable_json(body).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return isinstance(aggregate, str) and aggregate == expected


def assess_hybrid_activation(
    *,
    requested: bool,
    evidence_path: str | Path | None,
    model_path: str | Path | None,
    embedding_provider: str = "local-e5",
    allow_remote_embedding: bool = False,
    _evaluation_bootstrap: bool = False,
) -> HybridActivation:
    """Validate immutable promotion evidence before loading any model code."""
    if not requested:
        return HybridActivation(False, False, "not_requested")
    provider = str(embedding_provider).strip().lower()
    if provider not in {"local-e5", "qwen"}:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "embedding_provider_unsupported")
    if provider == "qwen" and not allow_remote_embedding:
        return HybridActivation(
            True,
            False,
            "remote_embedding_not_authorized",
            embedding_provider=provider,
        )
    if evidence_path is None:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_missing")
    candidate = Path(evidence_path).expanduser()
    if candidate.is_symlink():
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_unsafe_path")
    try:
        raw_evidence = _read_bounded_regular_file(
            candidate,
            maximum_bytes=MAX_EVIDENCE_BYTES,
        )
        payload = _strict_json_object(raw_evidence)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_missing")
    except OverflowError:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_oversized")
    except (OSError, RecursionError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_malformed")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_malformed")
    if provider == "qwen" and set(payload) != QWEN_PRODUCTION_EVIDENCE_KEYS:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_schema_mismatch")
    if payload.get("schema_version") != HYBRID_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_schema_mismatch")
    if payload.get("protocol_version") != HYBRID_PROTOCOL_VERSION:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_protocol_mismatch")
    if payload.get("inference_profile") != dict(HYBRID_PROMOTION_INFERENCE_PROFILE):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "inference_profile_mismatch")
    if payload.get("report_fingerprint") != evidence_fingerprint(payload):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_fingerprint_mismatch")
    if not hybrid_runtime_freeze_is_current(
        payload.get("runtime_implementation_freeze")
    ):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "runtime_implementation_drift")
    gate = payload.get("acceptance_gate")
    if provider == "qwen":
        if payload.get("synthetic_data") is not True:
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "evidence_schema_mismatch")
        if not _qwen_evaluator_freeze_is_well_formed(
            payload.get("implementation_freeze")
        ):
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "implementation_freeze_invalid")
        if _evaluation_bootstrap:
            if (
                gate != {"passed": True, "evaluation_bootstrap": True}
                or payload.get("production_enablement_allowed") is not False
            ):
                return HybridActivation(True, False, "evaluation_bootstrap_invalid")
        else:
            checks = gate.get("checks") if isinstance(gate, dict) else None
            if (
                not isinstance(gate, dict)
                or set(gate) != {"passed", "checks"}
                or gate.get("passed") is not True
                or not isinstance(checks, dict)
                or set(checks) != QWEN_PROMOTION_ACCEPTANCE_CHECK_KEYS
                or any(value is not True for value in checks.values())
            ):
                return HybridActivation(True, False, "acceptance_gate_failed")
            if payload.get("production_enablement_allowed") is not True:
                return HybridActivation(True, False, "production_not_authorized")
    else:
        if not isinstance(gate, dict) or gate.get("passed") is not True:
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "acceptance_gate_failed")
        if payload.get("production_enablement_allowed") is not True:
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "production_not_authorized")
    verifier = payload.get("verifier")
    if not isinstance(verifier, dict):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "verifier_evidence_missing")
    minimum_confidence = verifier.get("minimum_confidence")
    expected_prompt_sha = hashlib.sha256(
        HYBRID_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    if (
        verifier.get("prompt_version") != HYBRID_PROMPT_VERSION
        or verifier.get("prompt_sha256") != expected_prompt_sha
        or not isinstance(verifier.get("model_id"), str)
        or not verifier.get("model_id", "").strip()
        or isinstance(minimum_confidence, bool)
        or not isinstance(minimum_confidence, (int, float))
        or not math.isfinite(float(minimum_confidence))
        or not 0.0 <= float(minimum_confidence) <= 1.0
    ):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "verifier_evidence_invalid")
    challenger = payload.get("challenger")
    if not isinstance(challenger, dict):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "challenger_evidence_missing")
    challenger_confidence = challenger.get("minimum_confidence")
    veto_reason_codes = challenger.get("veto_reason_codes")
    expected_challenger_sha = hashlib.sha256(
        HYBRID_CHALLENGER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    if (
        challenger.get("prompt_version") != HYBRID_CHALLENGER_PROMPT_VERSION
        or challenger.get("prompt_sha256") != expected_challenger_sha
        or challenger.get("model_id") != verifier.get("model_id")
        or challenger.get("mode") != HYBRID_CHALLENGER_MODE
        or not isinstance(veto_reason_codes, (list, tuple))
        or set(veto_reason_codes) != HYBRID_CHALLENGER_VETO_REASONS
        or isinstance(challenger_confidence, bool)
        or not isinstance(challenger_confidence, (int, float))
        or not math.isfinite(float(challenger_confidence))
        or not 0.0 <= float(challenger_confidence) <= 1.0
    ):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "challenger_evidence_invalid")
    resolver = payload.get("resolver")
    if not isinstance(resolver, dict):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "resolver_evidence_missing")
    resolver_confidence = resolver.get("minimum_confidence")
    expected_resolver_sha = hashlib.sha256(
        HYBRID_RESOLVER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()
    if (
        resolver.get("prompt_version") != HYBRID_RESOLVER_PROMPT_VERSION
        or resolver.get("prompt_sha256") != expected_resolver_sha

            or set(holdout) != QWEN_PROMOTION_HOLDOUT_KEYS
            or holdout
            != {
                "version": QWEN_PROMOTION_DATASET_ID,
                "file_sha256": QWEN_PROMOTION_HOLDOUT_SHA256,
                "manifest_sha256": QWEN_PROMOTION_MANIFEST_SHA256,

            or set(promotion_report) != QWEN_PROMOTION_REPORT_REFERENCE_KEYS
            or promotion_report.get("artifact") != QWEN_PROMOTION_REPORT_ARTIFACT

        or not isinstance(max_model_calls, int)

    if not isinstance(evidence_model, dict):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "model_evidence_missing")

        canary_fingerprint = evidence_model.get("canary_fingerprint")
        remote_identity_is_valid = (
            set(evidence_model) == QWEN_EMBEDDING_IDENTITY_KEYS
            and evidence_model.get("provider") == "qwen"
            and evidence_model.get("model_id") == QWEN_EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID
            and str(evidence_model.get("endpoint", "")).rstrip("/")
            == QWEN_EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT
            and isinstance(dimension, int)
            and not isinstance(dimension, bool)
            and dimension == QWEN_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION
            and evidence_model.get("representation_version") == "memory-structured-v1"
            and evidence_model.get("canary_version") == "embedding-canary-v1"

            and len(canary_fingerprint) == 64
            and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in canary_fingerprint)

                True,

                evidence_path=candidate.resolve(),

                embedding_provider=provider,
            )

            payload.get("report_fingerprint")
            != HYBRID_ACCEPTED_QWEN_PROMOTION_FINGERPRINT
        ):
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "promotion_not_allowlisted")
        return HybridActivation(
            True,
            True,
            "activated",
            evidence_path=candidate.resolve(),
            evidence=payload,
            embedding_provider=provider,
        )

        return HybridActivation(True, False, "model_missing")
    local_model = Path(model_path).expanduser()
    manifest_path = local_model / "model_manifest.json"
    if (
        local_model.is_symlink()
        or not manifest_path.is_file()
        or manifest_path.is_symlink()
    ):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "model_missing")
    try:
        manifest = _strict_json_object(manifest_path.read_bytes())
    except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "model_manifest_malformed")
    for field in ("model_id", "model_revision", "model_fingerprint"):
        if manifest.get(field) != evidence_model.get(field):
            return HybridActivation(True, False, "model_identity_mismatch")
    if payload.get("report_fingerprint") != HYBRID_ACCEPTED_PROMOTION_FINGERPRINT:
        return HybridActivation(True, False, "promotion_not_allowlisted")
    return HybridActivation(
        True,
        True,
        "activated",
        evidence_path=candidate.resolve(),
        model_path=local_model.resolve(),
        evidence=payload,
        embedding_provider=provider,
    )

def _stable_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def build_hybrid_runtime_freeze(root: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Hash the closed production source set used by retrieval and admission."""

    repository_root = (
        Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
        if root is not None
        else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    )
    rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for relative in HYBRID_RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR_FILES:
        candidate = repository_root / relative
        resolved = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
        if (
            candidate.is_symlink()
            or not candidate.is_file()
            or repository_root not in resolved.parents
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"hybrid runtime source is missing or unsafe: {relative}")
        rows.append({"path": relative, "sha256": _sha256_file(candidate)})
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema_version": HYBRID_RUNTIME_FREEZE_VERSION,
        "file_count": len(rows),
        "files": rows,
    }
    return {
        **body,
        "aggregate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            _stable_json(body).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest(),
    }


def hybrid_runtime_freeze_is_current(value: Any) -> bool:
    """Fail closed when promoted evidence no longer matches installed code."""

    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return False
    try:
        return value == build_hybrid_runtime_freeze()
    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError):
        return False

def _ordered_lexical_candidate_ids(
    values: Sequence[str] | frozenset[str],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Preserve canonical lexical evidence order; stabilize legacy sets."""

    if isinstance(values, (set, frozenset)):
        candidates = sorted(values)
    elif isinstance(values, (list, tuple)):
        candidates = list(values)
    else:
        raise TypeError("lexical candidate IDs must be an ordered sequence")
    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item for item in candidates):
        raise ValueError("lexical candidate IDs must be non-empty strings")
    if len(candidates) != len(set(candidates)):
        raise ValueError("lexical candidate IDs must be unique")
    return tuple(candidates)


def _take_complete_candidate_lane(
    ordered_ids: Sequence[str],
    *,
    eligible: dict[str, Any],
    limit: int,
    excluded_ids: set[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Fill one lane without letting incomplete model inputs consume slots."""

    accepted: list[str] = []
    rejected: list[str] = []
    seen = set(excluded_ids or ())
    for entry_id in ordered_ids:
        if len(accepted) >= limit:
            break
        if entry_id in seen or entry_id not in eligible:
            continue
        seen.add(entry_id)
        if not _bounded_projection_is_complete(
            getattr(eligible[entry_id], "content", ""),
            MAX_CLASSIFIER_CONTENT_CHARS,
        ):
            rejected.append(entry_id)
            continue
        accepted.append(entry_id)
    return accepted, rejected

    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
        return {}
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    identity_keys = {
        "alias_from",
        "alias_to",
        "correction_id",
        "path",
        "paths",
        "files",
        "file_paths",
        "migration_id",
        "renamed_from",
        "renamed_to",
        "supersedes",
    }
    for key in (
        "alias_from",
        "alias_to",
        "path",
        "paths",
        "files",
        "file_paths",
        "relation",
        "component",
        "library",
        "version",
        "config_key",
        "value",
        "renamed_from",
        "renamed_to",
        "migration_id",
        "correction_id",
        "supersedes",
    ):
        value = metadata.get(key)
        if key in identity_keys:
            values = (value,) if isinstance(value, str) else value
            projected = bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(values)
            if not projected:
                continue
            result[key] = projected[0] if isinstance(value, str) else list(projected)
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
            result[key] = _normalized(value, 256)
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            result[key] = list(_bounded_strings(value))
    return result


def _entry_is_dense_eligible(entry: Any) -> bool:
    tier = getattr(entry, "tier", None)
    tier_value = getattr(tier, "value", tier)
    return (
        getattr(entry, "approval_status", "") == "approved"
        and getattr(entry, "lifecycle_status", "") == "active"
        and getattr(entry, "safety_status", "") == "safe"
        and not bool(getattr(entry, "curator_locked", False))
        and tier_value != "archival"
        and bool(_normalized(getattr(entry, "content", ""), MAX_CONTENT_CHARS))
    )


def _entry_document(entry: Any) -> str:
    fields = _canonical_entry_fields(entry, content_limit=MAX_CONTENT_CHARS)
    parts = [
        f"content: {fields['content']}",
        f"category: {fields['category']}",
    ]
    tags = fields["tags"]
    domains = fields["domains"]
    metadata = fields["metadata"]
    if tags:
        parts.append(f"tags: {' | '.join(tags)}")
    if domains:
        parts.append(f"domains: {' | '.join(domains)}")
    if metadata:
        parts.append(f"metadata: {_stable_json(metadata)}")
    return "\n".join(parts)


def _canonical_entry_fields(
    entry: Any,
    *,
    content_limit: int = MAX_CLASSIFIER_CONTENT_CHARS,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the structured, bounded entry projection seen by semantic stages."""

    scope = getattr(entry, "scope", None)
    return {
        "content": _normalized(getattr(entry, "content", ""), content_limit),
        "scope": getattr(scope, "value", scope),
        "category": _normalized(getattr(entry, "category", ""), 128),
        # Tags and domains can carry identifiers. Drop an overlong value
        # instead of fabricating an apparently exact prefix.
        "tags": list(
            bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(getattr(entry, "tags", ()))
        ),
        "domains": list(
            bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(getattr(entry, "domains", ()))
        ),
        "metadata": _safe_metadata(getattr(entry, "metadata", {})),
    }


def _canonical_request_fields(request: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the sole bounded request projection used by every semantic stage."""

    return {
        "query": _normalized(getattr(request, "query", ""), MAX_QUERY_CHARS),
        "current_files": list(
            bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(
                getattr(request, "current_files", ())
            )
        ),
        "active_domains": list(
            bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(
                getattr(request, "active_domains", ()),
                lowercase=True,
            )
        ),
    }


def _query_document(request: Any) -> str:
    fields = _canonical_request_fields(request)
    parts = [f"task: {fields['query']}"]
    files = fields["current_files"]
    domains = fields["active_domains"]
    if files:
        parts.append(f"current_files: {' | '.join(files)}")
    if domains:
        parts.append(f"active_domains: {' | '.join(domains)}")
    return "\n".join(parts)


_QUERY_SEGMENT_KINDS = {
    "task": "query.task",
    "current_files": "query.current_files",
    "active_domains": "query.active_domains",
}
_MEMORY_SEGMENT_KINDS = {
    "content": "memory.content",
    "category": "memory.category",
    "tags": "memory.tags",
    "domains": "memory.domains",
    "metadata": "memory.metadata",
}


def _proof_segments(
    document: str,
    prefix: str,
    *,
    side: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
    """Create bounded exact-source segments that a resolver can cite by ID."""

    kind_map = (
        _QUERY_SEGMENT_KINDS
        if side == "query"
        else _MEMORY_SEGMENT_KINDS
        if side == "memory"
        else None
    )
    if kind_map is None:
        raise ValueError("hybrid resolver proof segment side is invalid")
    segments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    cursor = 0
    for raw_line in document.splitlines(keepends=True):
        line = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
        line_start = cursor
        cursor += len(raw_line)
        label = line.partition(":")[0].strip()
        kind = kind_map.get(label)
        if kind is None:
            raise ValueError("hybrid resolver proof segment source is invalid")
        for offset in range(0, len(line), 480):
            fragment = line[offset : offset + 480].strip()
            if not fragment or not any(character.isalnum() for character in fragment):
                continue
            start = document.find(fragment, line_start + offset, line_start + len(line))
            if start < 0:
                raise ValueError("hybrid resolver segment projection failed")
            segments.append(
                {
                    "id": f"{prefix}{len(segments) + 1}",
                    "kind": kind,
                    "text": fragment,
                    "start": start,
                    "end": start + len(fragment),
                }
            )
    if not segments or len(segments) > MAX_RESOLVER_SEGMENTS_PER_SIDE:
        raise ValueError("hybrid resolver document has no proof segments")
    return tuple(segments)


def _resolver_pair_prefix(entry_id: str) -> str:
    digest = _sha256_bytes(entry_id.encode("utf-8"))[:20]
    return f"p-{digest}-"


def _build_resolver_batch(
    items: Sequence[tuple[Any, Any]],
    *,
    decisions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    audits: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Build the sole production/evaluator resolver payload contract."""

    entry_ids = [str(entry.id) for _request, entry in items]
    if (
        not items
        or len(entry_ids) > DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE
        or len(entry_ids) != len(set(entry_ids))
        or set(entry_ids) != set(decisions)
        or set(entry_ids) != set(audits)
    ):
        raise ValueError("hybrid resolver batch identity is invalid")
    pairs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    expected: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    all_segment_ids: set[str] = set()
    for request, entry in items:
        audit = audits[entry.id]
        if (
            audit.get("admit") is not False
            or audit.get("reasonCode") not in HYBRID_CHALLENGER_VETO_REASONS
            or audit.get("reasonCode") in HYBRID_RESOLVER_NON_OVERRIDABLE_VETO_REASONS
        ):
            raise ValueError("hybrid resolver received an ineligible disagreement")
        pair_prefix = _resolver_pair_prefix(str(entry.id))
        query_segments = _proof_segments(
            _query_document(request), f"{pair_prefix}q", side="query"
        )
        memory_segments = _proof_segments(
            _entry_document(entry), f"{pair_prefix}m", side="memory"
        )
        segment_ids = {segment["id"] for segment in (*query_segments, *memory_segments)}
        if len(segment_ids) != len(query_segments) + len(memory_segments):
            raise ValueError("hybrid resolver pair has duplicate segment IDs")
        if all_segment_ids.intersection(segment_ids):
            raise ValueError("hybrid resolver batch has cross-pair segment collision")
        all_segment_ids.update(segment_ids)
        pair = {
            "id": entry.id,
            "queryEvidenceSegments": [
                {
                    "id": segment["id"],
                    "kind": segment["kind"],
                    "text": segment["text"],
                }
                for segment in query_segments
            ],
            "memoryEvidenceSegments": [
                {
                    "id": segment["id"],
                    "kind": segment["kind"],
                    "text": segment["text"],
                }
                for segment in memory_segments
            ],
            "verifiedRecoveryAuthority": _entry_has_verified_recovery(entry),
            "verifiedCauseAuthority": _entry_has_verified_cause(entry),
            "primary": {
                key: decisions[entry.id][key]
                for key in (
                    "decision",
                    "confidence",
                    "objectMatch",
                    "relationSupported",
                    "reasonCode",
                )
            },
            "challenger": {
                key: audits[entry.id][key]
                for key in ("admit", "confidence", "reasonCode")
            },
        }
        if len(_stable_json(pair)) > MAX_RESOLVER_CHARS_PER_PAIR:
            raise ValueError("hybrid resolver pair exceeds the proof input budget")
        pairs.append(pair)
        expected[entry.id] = {
            "query_segments": {
                segment["id"]: {
                    "start": segment["start"],
                    "end": segment["end"],
                    "kind": segment["kind"],
                }
                for segment in query_segments
            },
            "memory_segments": {
                segment["id"]: {
                    "start": segment["start"],
                    "end": segment["end"],
                    "kind": segment["kind"],
                }
                for segment in memory_segments
            },
            "contested_reason": audits[entry.id]["reasonCode"],
        }
    if len(_stable_json({"pairs": pairs})) > MAX_RESOLVER_CHARS_PER_BATCH:
        raise ValueError("hybrid resolver batch exceeds the proof input budget")
    return pairs, expected


def _resolver_input_rejection(
    entry_id: str,
    *,
    contested_reason: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a local deny result when one proof projection is unrepresentable."""

    return {
        "id": entry_id,
        "decision": "irrelevant",
        "confidence": 1.0,
        "queryGrounded": False,
        "objectMatch": False,
        "relationSupported": False,
        "supportKind": "none",
        "disqualifier": "unsupported_relation",
        "contestedReason": contested_reason,
        "querySpan": {},
        "memorySpan": {},
        "querySegmentKind": "",
        "memorySegmentKind": "",
        "runtimeReason": "resolver_input_budget_rejected",
    }


def _query_has_concrete_object(request: Any) -> bool:
    if bounded_hybrid_identity_strings(getattr(request, "current_files", ())):
        return True
    text = _normalized(getattr(request, "query", ""), MAX_QUERY_CHARS).lower()
    if not text:
        return False
    if re.search(r"(?:[/\\]|\b[a-z0-9_-]+\.[a-z0-9]{1,12}\b)", text):
        return True
    ascii_terms = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*", text)
    informative_ascii_terms = {
        term for term in ascii_terms if term not in _GENERIC_QUERY_TERMS
    }
    # A single bare noun ("fix the cache") is not enough authority to send
    # stored guidance to a semantic model.  Require either explicit file
    # context or two independently useful object/operation terms.
    if len(informative_ascii_terms) >= 2:
        return True
    non_ascii = "".join(character for character in text if ord(character) > 127)
    for generic in _GENERIC_CJK_QUERY_PARTS:
        non_ascii = non_ascii.replace(generic, "")
    return (
        sum(character.isalpha() or character.isdigit() for character in non_ascii) >= 2
    )

def _normalized_path(value: Any) -> str:
    projected = bounded_hybrid_identity_strings((value,))
    if not projected:
        return ""
    # Preserve path case.  The retrieval runtime does not own a trustworthy
    # workspace-filesystem case-sensitivity signal, so folding here could turn
    # two distinct paths on a case-sensitive checkout into deterministic proof
    # of identity (or of a migration).  Uncertain case-only matches remain
    # available to semantic adjudication; they must not bypass it.
    return normalize_path_identity(projected[0])


def _paths_in_text(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    return set(extract_complete_path_identities(value, max_text_chars=4_000))


def _metadata_paths(metadata: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> set[str]:
    paths: set[str] = set()
    for key in keys:
        value = metadata.get(key)
        values = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else (value,)
        for item in values:
            if isinstance(item, str) and (normalized := _normalized_path(item)):
                paths.add(normalized)
    return paths


def _query_paths(request: Any) -> set[str]:
    fields = _canonical_request_fields(request)
    return {
        *(
            _normalized_path(path)
            for path in fields["current_files"]
            if _normalized_path(path)
        ),
        *_paths_in_text(fields["query"]),
    }


def _contains_any(text: str, markers: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    return any(marker in text for marker in markers)


def _contains_intent_marker(text: str, markers: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    """Match ASCII intent words on token boundaries and CJK markers literally."""

    for marker in markers:
        if marker.isascii():
            if re.search(
                rf"(?<![a-z0-9]){re.escape(marker)}(?![a-z0-9])",
                text,
            ):
                return True
        elif marker in text:
            return True
    return False


def _query_has_current_configuration_intent(query: str) -> bool:
    """Require unambiguous current/imperative evidence before stale vetoes."""

    if _contains_intent_marker(query, _CURRENT_CONFIGURATION_QUERY_MARKERS):
        return True
    # `set` is tense-ambiguous ("who set it" is historical). It is current
    # authority only in an imperative or modal construction.
    return bool(
        re.search(
            r"(?:^|[.!?]\s*)(?:please\s+)?set\b|"
            r"\b(?:must|should|need\s+to|want\s+to|can\s+you|could\s+you)\s+set\b",
            query,
        )
    )


def _query_has_historical_configuration_intent(query: str) -> bool:
    """Recognize explanatory and past-tense configuration requests."""

    if _contains_intent_marker(
        query,
        _HISTORICAL_CONFIGURATION_QUERY_MARKERS,
    ):
        return True
    if re.search(
        r"\b(?:audit|trace|investigate)?\s*(?:who|when)\b.{0,120}"
        r"\b(?:set|configured|enabled|installed|removed)\b",
        query,
    ):
        return True
    cjk_verbs = r"(?:设置|配置|启用|应用|添加|恢复|采用|安装|开启)"
    return bool(
        re.search(
            rf"(?:审计|追溯|调查|谁|是谁|何时|什么时候|当时|曾经)"
            rf".{{0,160}}{cjk_verbs}",
            query,
        )
        or re.search(rf"{cjk_verbs}(?:过|了)", query)
    )


def _content_has_post_removal_guidance(content: str) -> bool:
    """Detect affirmative replacement guidance on either side of removal."""

    if not _contains_any(content, _REMOVED_MARKERS):
        return False
    clauses = tuple(
        clause.strip()
        for clause in re.split(r"[.;!?。；！？\r\n]+", content)
        if clause.strip()
    )
    positive_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(?:use|using|configure|set|enable|adopt|replace(?:d|ment)?)\b"
    )
    negative_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(?:do\s+not|don't|never|avoid|without|instead\s+of|used\s+to|"
        r"was\s+using|if|might|could)\b"
    )
    for clause in clauses:
        has_positive = bool(positive_pattern.search(clause)) or _contains_any(
            clause,
            ("改用", "使用", "配置", "设置", "启用", "替代", "取代"),
        )
        if not has_positive:
            continue
        has_negative = bool(negative_pattern.search(clause)) or _contains_any(
            clause,
            (
                "不要",
                "不得",
                "禁止",
                "不再",
                "未",
                "曾经",
                "过去",
                "如果",
                "可能",
            ),
        )
        if not has_negative:
            return True
    return False
